hi.R: यिर्मयाह ने कहा: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे यह संदेश दिया:

ru.L: И сказал Иеремия: Было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} ко мне, говоря:
ru.B: Иеремия сказал: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обратился ко мне:
ru.R: Иеремия сказал: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал мне такое слово:

ja.L: エレミヤは言った。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がわたしに臨んで言った。
ja.B: エレミヤは言った。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がわたしに臨んだ。
ja.R: エレミヤは言いました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしに次のように語られました。

uk.L: І сказав Єремія: Було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до мене, кажучи:
uk.B: Єремія сказав: Було до мене слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}:
uk.R: Єремія сказав: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав мені таке послання:

decisions.choice: Jeremiah said: his own account of the purchase and his prayer follow, to verse 25
decisions.reason: After the setting in verses 1-5, Jeremiah tells in the first person how the word came, how he bought the field (verses 7-15) and how he prayed (verses 16-25). From verse 26 the narrator speaks of him again by name, and the LORD's answer runs to verse 44.

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD came to me, saying (L); came to me (B); The LORD gave me this message (R); no quotation marks for Jeremiah's account
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula throughout Jeremiah. Jeremiah's first-person account is set as narrative, without quotation marks, as in 13:1-11 and 24:1-10; the words of the LORD and of others within it take quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's own account (verses 6-25) without quotation marks, in the first-person narrative tenses (passé simple at L and B, passé composé at R)
decisions.reason: As the English and the terms note set it for Jeremiah's first-person narrative; his prayer (verses 17-25) is speech and keeps the tenses of speech.

decisions.choice: No quotation marks for Jeremiah's own account
decisions.reason: As the English: Jeremiah tells the purchase and his prayer in his own voice (meaning decision m1), so his account is not set in quotation marks; God's words inside it are.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन X के पास पहुँचा (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने X को यह संदेश दिया (R)
decisions.reason: "The word of the LORD came to X" in the terms note's wording, as 1:4 and 24:4. Literal renders "saying" with कि.

decisions.choice: Было слово ГОСПОДА ко мне, говоря (L); ГОСПОДЬ обратился ко мне (B); ГОСПОДЬ дал мне такое слово (R)
decisions.reason: The formula "the word of the LORD came to X" in the wording the Prophets note sets for each level, as in Jeremiah 1:4. Jeremiah's own account that follows takes no quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's own account (verses 6-25) without quotation marks, as the English (m1): first person "わたし", narration plain (L, B), です・ます (R); the formula vayhi devar YHWH 'elai "{D}の言葉がわたしに臨んで言った" (L), "臨んだ" (B), "語られました" (R).
decisions.reason: JER-1 formulas and register.

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן־שַׁלֻּם֙ דֹּֽדְךָ֔ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle [is] coming to you, saying, Buy for yourself my field which [is] in Anathoth, for to you [belongs] the right of the redemption to buy.

en.L: "Look, Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is coming to you, saying, 'Buy for yourself my field that [is] at Anathoth, for the right of redemption [is] yours, to buy [it].'"
en.B: "Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is going to come to you and say, 'Buy my field at Anathoth, for as the family redeemer you have the right to buy it.'"
en.R: "Your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to see you. He will say, 'Buy my field at Anathoth. You are the family redeemer, so you have the right to buy it and keep it in the family.'"

es.L: «He aquí, Hanamel hijo de Salum, tu tío, viene a ti, diciendo: “Cómprate mi campo que [está] en Anatot, porque a ti te corresponde el derecho de rescate para comprar[lo]”».
es.B: «Hanamel, el hijo de tu tío Salum, vendrá a ti y te dirá: “Compra mi campo de Anatot, porque como pariente redentor tienes el derecho de comprarlo”».
es.R: «Tu primo Hanamel, el hijo de tu tío Salum, va a venir a verte. Te dirá: “Compra mi campo de Anatot. Tú eres el pariente que debe rescatar la tierra, así que tienes el derecho de comprarla para que quede en la familia”».

fr.L: « Voici, Hanaméel fils de Shalloum, ton oncle, vient vers toi, pour dire : “Achète-toi mon champ qui [est] à Anatoth, car le droit de rachat est à toi pour l’acheter.” »
fr.B: « Hanaméel, le fils de ton oncle Shalloum, va venir te dire : “Achète mon champ d’Anatoth, car c’est toi qui as le droit de rachat comme proche parent.” »
fr.R: « Ton cousin Hanaméel, le fils de ton oncle Shalloum, va venir te voir. Il te dira : “Achète mon champ d’Anatoth. C’est toi le proche parent qui a le droit de racheter, alors tu as le droit de l’acheter pour qu’il reste dans la famille.” »

sw.L: "Tazama, Hanameli mwana wa Shalumu baba yako mdogo anakuja kwako, akisema, 'Jinunulie shamba langu lililo Anathothi, kwa maana haki ya ukombozi [ni] yako, kulinunua.'"
sw.B: "Hanameli, mwana wa baba yako mdogo Shalumu, atakuja kwako na kusema, 'Nunua shamba langu lililoko Anathothi, kwa maana wewe kama mkombozi wa jamaa una haki ya kulinunua.'"
sw.R: "Binamu yako Hanameli, mwana wa baba yako mdogo Shalumu, anakuja kukuona. Atasema, 'Nunua shamba langu lililoko Anathothi. Wewe ndiye mkombozi wa jamaa, kwa hiyo una haki ya kulinunua ili libaki katika jamaa.'"

vi.L: "Kìa, Ha-na-mên con trai Sa-lum, chú của ngươi, sẽ đến với ngươi mà nói: 'Hãy mua cho mình cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt, vì anh có quyền chuộc để mua [nó].'"
vi.B: "Ha-na-mên, con trai Sa-lum chú của con, sắp đến gặp con mà nói: 'Anh hãy mua cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt, vì anh là người có quyền chuộc sản nghiệp trong gia đình nên có quyền mua.'"
vi.R: "Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của con, là con trai Sa-lum chú của con, sắp đến gặp con. Anh ấy sẽ nói: 'Anh hãy mua cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt. Anh là người có quyền chuộc sản nghiệp, nên anh có quyền mua để giữ cánh đồng ấy trong gia đình.'"

ko.L: "보아라, 네 삼촌 살룸의 아들 하나멜이 너에게 와서 '아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 당신을 위하여 사시오. 그것을 살 무를 권리가 당신에게 있소.' 하고 말할 것이다."
ko.B: "네 삼촌 살룸의 아들 하나멜이 너에게 와서 '아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 사 주시오. 가까운 친척으로서 그 밭을 무를 권리가 당신에게 있소.' 하고 말할 것이다."
ko.R: "네 사촌 하나멜, 곧 네 삼촌 살룸의 아들이 너를 찾아올 것이다. 그가 이렇게 말할 것이다. '아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 사 주시오. 당신은 가장 가까운 친척이니, 그 밭을 사서 우리 집안의 땅으로 지킬 권리가 있소.'"

pt.L: "Eis que Hanamel, filho de Salum, teu tio, vem a ti, dizendo: 'Compre para você o meu campo que [está] em Anatote, pois o direito de resgate [é] seu, para comprar.'"
pt.B: "Hanamel, filho do teu tio Salum, virá a ti e dirá: 'Compre o meu campo em Anatote, pois, como resgatador da família, você tem o direito de comprá-lo.'"
pt.R: "O teu primo Hanamel, filho do teu tio Salum, vem te visitar. Ele vai dizer: 'Compre o meu campo em Anatote. Você é o resgatador da família, por isso tem o direito de comprá-lo e de mantê-lo na família.'"

am.L: «እነሆ፣ የአጎትህ የሰሎም ልጅ ሐናምኤል ወደ አንተ ይመጣል፤ እንዲህም ይልሃል፦ “በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ለአንተ ግዛ፤ ለመግዛት የመቤዠት መብት የአንተ ነውና።”»
am.B: «የአጎትህ የሰሎም ልጅ ሐናምኤል ወደ አንተ መጥቶ እንዲህ ይልሃል፦ “የቤተሰብ ቤዢ እንደ መሆንህ እርሻውን የመግዛት መብት የአንተ ነውና በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ግዛ።”»
am.R: «የአጎትህ የሰሎም ልጅ ሐናምኤል ሊያይህ ይመጣል። እንዲህም ይልሃል፦ “በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ግዛ። አንተ የቤተሰቡ ቤዢ ነህ፤ ስለዚህ እርሻውን ገዝተህ በቤተሰቡ እጅ እንዲቆይ የማድረግ መብት አለህ።”»

hi.L: "देखो, तुम्हारे चाचा शल्लूम का पुत्र हनमेल तुम्हारे पास यह कहते हुए आ रहा है, 'अनातोत में जो मेरा खेत है, उसे अपने लिए मोल ले लो, क्योंकि उसे मोल लेने के लिए छुड़ाने का अधिकार तुम्हारा है।'"
hi.B: "तुम्हारे चाचा शल्लूम का पुत्र हनमेल तुम्हारे पास आकर कहेगा, 'अनातोत में मेरा खेत मोल ले लो, क्योंकि कुल के छुड़ानेवाले के नाते उसे मोल लेने का अधिकार तुम्हारा है।'"
hi.R: "तुम्हारा चचेरा भाई हनमेल, जो तुम्हारे चाचा शल्लूम का बेटा है, तुमसे मिलने आ रहा है। वह कहेगा, 'अनातोत में मेरा खेत ख़रीद लो। तुम कुल के छुड़ानेवाले हो, इसलिए उसे ख़रीदकर परिवार में बनाए रखने का अधिकार तुम्हारा है।'"

ru.L: «Вот, Анамеил, сын Селлума, твоего дяди, идёт к тебе, чтобы сказать: “Купи себе моё поле, которое в Анафофе, ведь за тобой право выкупа — купить [его].”»
ru.B: «Анамеил, сын твоего дяди Селлума, придёт к тебе и скажет: “Купи моё поле в Анафофе, ведь ты как выкупщик семьи имеешь право купить его.”»
ru.R: «Твой двоюродный брат Анамеил, сын твоего дяди Селлума, придёт к тебе и скажет: “Купи моё поле в Анафофе. Ты выкупщик нашей семьи, поэтому у тебя есть право купить его, чтобы оно осталось в семье.”»

ja.L: 「見なさい、あなたのおじシャルムの子ハナムエルが、あなたのもとに来て言う。『アナトトにあるわたしの畑をあなたのために買ってください。買い戻しの権利があなたにあるので、あなたが買うのです』と。」
ja.B: 「あなたのおじシャルムの子ハナムエルが、あなたのところに来て言う。『アナトトにあるわたしの畑を買ってください。親族として買い戻す権利が、あなたにあるのです』と。」
ja.R: 「あなたのいとこで、おじシャルムの息子であるハナムエルが、あなたに会いに来る。そして言う。『アナトトにあるわたしの畑を買ってください。あなたは親族として、その畑を買い戻して、家族のものとして守る権利があるのです』と。」

uk.L: «Ось Ханамеїл, син Шаллума, твого дядька, приходить до тебе, кажучи: “Купи собі моє поле, що [в] Анатоті, бо тобі [належить] право викупу, щоб купити [його]”».
uk.B: «Ханамеїл, син твого дядька Шаллума, прийде до тебе й скаже: “Купи моє поле в Анатоті, бо як родичеві-викупителеві тобі належить право купити його”».
uk.R: «Твій двоюрідний брат Ханамеїл, син твого дядька Шаллума, прийде до тебе. Він скаже: “Купи моє поле в Анатоті. Ти родич-викупитель, тож маєш право купити його, щоб воно залишилося в родині”».

decisions.choice: the right of redemption: the duty and right of the nearest relative to buy family land so it is not lost to the family
decisions.reason: The Law said that when an Israelite became poor and had to sell land, his nearest relative, his redeemer (go'el), should come and buy back what was sold (Leviticus 25:25). Land was the family's lasting share in the land the LORD had given, and it was meant to stay in the family (Leviticus 25:23-24; Numbers 27:8-11). Ruth 4:1-10 shows a redeemer buying a field in the same way. Hanamel offers Jeremiah, as next in line, the first right to buy.

decisions.choice: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle: Jeremiah's first cousin
decisions.reason: The word means a father's brother, an uncle. Shallum was the brother of Jeremiah's father Hilkiah (1:1), so his son Hanamel was Jeremiah's cousin. This Shallum is not King Shallum of 22:11; the name was common.

decisions.choice: Anathoth: Jeremiah's home town
decisions.reason: Anathoth was a town of priests in the land of Benjamin, a few miles north of Jerusalem (1:1; Joshua 21:18). Its men had once plotted to kill Jeremiah (11:21-23). The land around it was now held by the Babylonian army.

decisions.choice: look: God tells Jeremiah in advance what will happen
decisions.reason: The LORD announces the visit before it comes, so that when Hanamel arrives Jeremiah will know the offer is from the LORD (verse 8).

decisions.choice: redemption (L); family redeemer (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun "redemption". Balanced and Readable name the one who holds the right, the "family redeemer", as in Ruth 2:20, so that readers see that it is a family duty and not a religious term.

decisions.choice: Your cousin (R); and keep it in the family (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the relationship and says what redeeming the field was for.

decisions.choice: el derecho de rescate (Literal); pariente redentor (Balanced); el pariente que debe rescatar la tierra (Readable)
decisions.reason: The right of the nearest relative to buy family land (meaning decision m1); Balanced uses "redentor", the word the terms note sets for *goʾel*, and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: Hanamel
decisions.reason: The name follows the Hebrew form, as the data's English does.

decisions.choice: baba mdogo
decisions.reason: Hebrew *dod* is the father's brother. Swahili "mjomba" properly means the mother's brother, so every level says "baba (yako/yangu) mdogo", as the published 1 Samuel 10:14 ("baba mdogo wa Sauli") and 2 Kings 24:17 ("baba mdogo wa Yehoyakini"); 32:8, 9 and 12 L follow. Readable and Basic call Hanameli "binamu" (cousin) where the English does.

decisions.choice: haki ya ukombozi (Literal); mkombozi wa jamaa (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The kinsman's right to buy back family land (Leviticus 25:25), with "kukomboa" as the terms note sets for redeeming.

decisions.choice: "Hanaméel fils de Shalloum"; "le droit de rachat" (L, B), "le proche parent qui a le droit de racheter" (R)
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the name; the right of the go'el is named with "racheter", the verb the terms note sets for this root, as in Ruth.

decisions.choice: "quyền chuộc" (L); "người có quyền chuộc sản nghiệp" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The redemption of family land (go'el), worded with "chuộc", the verb used for God's redeeming in 31:11, so the reader hears the same idea. The cousins say "anh" and "tôi" to each other.

decisions.choice: "무를 권리" (L, B); "사서 집안의 땅으로 지킬 권리" (R)
decisions.reason: The nearest relative's right to buy back family land (meaning decision m1); "무르다" is the Korean word used for redeeming family land (Ruth, Leviticus), kept apart from "구속하다", which the terms note keeps for God as Redeemer.

decisions.choice: Hanamel speaks to Jeremiah in 하오체 ("사 주시오", "있소")
decisions.reason: Cousins of the same generation speaking on family business; 하오체 is the courteous level between adult relatives in a formal matter, a choice open to review.

decisions.choice: o direito de resgate (L); como resgatador da família / o resgatador da família (B, R)
decisions.reason: The go'el's right (m1) takes the words Leviticus 25:25 and Ruth 2:20 set in Portuguese, "resgatar", "o resgatador", "o resgatador da família", so that the reader sees a family duty, not a religious term.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Jeremiah); você (Hanamel to his cousin)
decisions.reason: God speaks to Jeremiah with "tu" ("teu tio", "vem a ti"); Hanamel, a relative, speaks to Jeremiah with "você", as people speak to each other.

decisions.choice: "የመቤዠት መብት" for the right of redemption; "ቤዢ" for the family redeemer
decisions.reason: The Leviticus 25 words on main: gaʾal is "ቤዠ" and the kinsman-redeemer "ቤዢ"; Hanamel, a cousin, says "አንተ" as family do.

decisions.choice: "родич-викупитель" for the go'el, the kinsman with the right and duty to buy back family land
decisions.reason: A compound that names both the kinship and the buying back, as the English "family redeemer"; "викупитель" alone would read as a religious title.

decisions.choice: हनमेल; शल्लूम; अनातोत
decisions.reason: Hanamel is हनमेल, transcribed from the Hebrew; his father Shallum is शल्लूम, as 1 Chronicles 2-3 and 2 Kings have the name; Anathoth is अनातोत, as Jeremiah 1:1. The cousins speak to each other with तुम.

decisions.choice: छुड़ाने का अधिकार (L); कुल का छुड़ानेवाला (B, R)
decisions.reason: The redeemer's right is said with छुड़ाना, the verb Leviticus 25:25 and Ruth 4 use in this translation for buying back family land; Balanced and Readable name the कुल का छुड़ानेवाला, as the English names the family redeemer.

decisions.choice: Анамеил; Селлум; Анафоф
decisions.reason: Hanamel takes the traditional Russian form Анамеил; Shallum is Селлум, the form used for every Shallum in Kings, Chronicles and Ezra in this translation; Anathoth is Анафоф, as in Jeremiah 1:1.

decisions.choice: право выкупа (L); выкупщик семьи (B, R)
decisions.reason: The right and duty of the nearest relative to buy back family land (meaning m1). Literal keeps the noun; Balanced and Readable name the one who holds the right, "выкупщик", the word Ruth 2:20 and 3:9 use in this translation.

decisions.choice: Chanam'el "ハナムエル" (new), son of Shallum "シャルム" Jeremiah's uncle (dod) "おじ"; R "いとこ" as the English R (m2); mishpat hagge'ullah "買い戻しの権利" (L), "親族として買い戻す権利" (B, R), the near relative's right and duty (m1), as "買い戻す" in Ruth.
decisions.reason: Hanamel speaks politely to his kinsman, a request ("買ってください"), since he asks a favor (m4 of 32:8 marks the polite na').

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַי חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־דֹּדִ֜י כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־חֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י קְנֵ֣ה נָ֠א אֶת־שָׂדִ֨י אֲשֶׁר־בַּעֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀בְּאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי־לְךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַיְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּלְךָ֥ הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה־לָ֑ךְ וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And came to me Hanamel son of my uncle according to [the] word of Yahweh to [the] courtyard of the guard, and he said to me, Buy please my field which [is] in Anathoth which [is] in [the] land of Benjamin, for to you [belongs the] right of the possession, and to you the redemption; buy for yourself. And I knew that [the] word of Yahweh it [was].

en.L: And Hanamel the son of my uncle came to me, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to the courtyard of the guard, and he said to me, "Buy, please, my field that [is] at Anathoth, which [is] in the land of Benjamin, for the right of possession [is] yours, and the redemption [is] yours; buy [it] for yourself." And I knew that this [was] the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then my cousin Hanamel visited me in the courtyard of the guard, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said. He told me, "Please buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. The right of inheritance is yours, and so is the right of redemption; buy it for yourself." I knew then that this was the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then my cousin Hanamel came to see me in the courtyard of the guard, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told me he would. He said, "Please buy my field at Anathoth in the land of Benjamin. You have the right to inherit it, and you have the right to buy it back for the family. Buy it for yourself." Then I knew that this message had come from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y vino a mí Hanamel, el hijo de mi tío, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, al patio de la guardia, y me dijo: «Compra, te ruego, mi campo que [está] en Anatot, que [está] en la tierra de Benjamín, porque tuyo [es] el derecho de posesión, y tuyo el rescate; cómpra[lo] para ti». Y supe que era palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces mi primo Hanamel vino a verme al patio de la guardia, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Me dijo: «Por favor, compra mi campo de Anatot, en el territorio de Benjamín. Tuyo es el derecho de herencia, y tuyo también el derecho de rescate; cómpralo para ti». Entonces supe que esto era palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces mi primo Hanamel vino a verme al patio de la guardia, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me había dicho que haría. Me dijo: «Por favor, compra mi campo de Anatot, en la tierra de Benjamín. Tú tienes el derecho de heredarlo, y tienes el derecho de comprarlo para la familia. Cómpralo para ti». Entonces supe que ese mensaje había venido {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Hanaméel, le fils de mon oncle, vint vers moi, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans la cour de la garde, et il me dit : « Achète donc mon champ qui [est] à Anatoth, dans le pays de Benjamin, car le droit d’héritage est à toi, et le rachat est à toi ; achète-[le] pour toi. » Et je sus que c’[était] la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Alors mon cousin Hanaméel vint me trouver dans la cour de la garde, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit. Il me dit : « Achète donc mon champ d’Anatoth, dans le territoire de Benjamin. Le droit d’héritage est à toi, et le droit de rachat aussi ; achète-le pour toi. » Je compris alors que c’était la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors mon cousin Hanaméel est venu me voir dans la cour de la garde, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me l’avait annoncé. Il m’a dit : « S’il te plaît, achète mon champ d’Anatoth, dans le pays de Benjamin. Tu as le droit d’en hériter, et tu as le droit de le racheter pour la famille. Achète-le pour toi. » Alors j’ai su que ce message venait {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Basi Hanameli mwana wa baba yangu mdogo akanijia, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika ua wa walinzi, akaniambia, "Tafadhali nunua shamba langu lililo Anathothi, lililo katika nchi ya Benyamini, kwa maana haki ya urithi [ni] yako, na ukombozi [ni] wako; jinunulie." Ndipo nikajua kwamba hilo [lilikuwa] neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kisha binamu yangu Hanameli alinijia katika ua wa walinzi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema. Akaniambia, "Tafadhali nunua shamba langu lililoko Anathothi katika nchi ya Benyamini. Haki ya urithi ni yako, na haki ya ukombozi pia; jinunulie." Ndipo nikajua kwamba hilo lilikuwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha binamu yangu Hanameli alikuja kuniona katika ua wa walinzi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameniambia kwamba angekuja. Akasema, "Tafadhali nunua shamba langu lililoko Anathothi katika nchi ya Benyamini. Una haki ya kulirithi, na una haki ya kulinunua ili libaki katika jamaa. Jinunulie." Ndipo nikajua kwamba ujumbe ule ulikuwa umetoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ha-na-mên con trai chú tôi đến với tôi trong sân lính canh, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nói với tôi: "Xin anh hãy mua cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt, thuộc đất Bên-gia-min, vì quyền thừa hưởng [là] của anh, và quyền chuộc [là] của anh; hãy mua cho mình." Bấy giờ tôi biết rằng đó [là] lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Rồi Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi, đến thăm tôi trong sân lính canh, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán. Anh ấy nói với tôi: "Xin anh mua cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt, trong địa phận Bên-gia-min. Quyền thừa hưởng là của anh, quyền chuộc cũng là của anh; anh hãy mua lấy." Bấy giờ tôi biết đó là lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Rồi Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi, đến gặp tôi trong sân lính canh, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã báo trước. Anh ấy nói: "Xin anh mua cánh đồng của tôi ở A-na-tốt trong đất Bên-gia-min. Anh có quyền thừa hưởng nó, và anh có quyền chuộc nó lại cho gia đình. Anh hãy mua lấy." Bấy giờ tôi biết sứ điệp ấy đã đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 내 삼촌의 아들 하나멜이 경비대 뜰로 나에게 와서 말했다. "베냐민 땅 아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 부디 사시오. 상속할 권리가 당신에게 있고, 무를 권리도 당신에게 있으니, 당신을 위하여 사시오." 그래서 나는 그것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이었음을 알았다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 내 사촌 하나멜이 경비대 뜰로 나를 찾아와서 말했다. "베냐민 땅 아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 사 주시오. 상속할 권리도 당신에게 있고 무를 권리도 당신에게 있으니, 그 밭을 사시오." 그때 나는 그것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이었음을 알았다.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 내 사촌 하나멜이 경비대 뜰로 나를 찾아왔다. 그가 말했다. "베냐민 땅 아나돗에 있는 내 밭을 사 주시오. 당신에게는 그 밭을 물려받을 권리가 있고, 집안을 위해 그 밭을 되살 권리도 있소. 그 밭을 사시오." 그때 나는 그 말씀이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 것이었음을 알았다.

pt.L: E Hanamel, filho do meu tio, veio a mim, conforme a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ao pátio da guarda, e me disse: "Compre, por favor, o meu campo que [está] em Anatote, que [fica] na terra de Benjamim, pois o direito de posse [é] seu, e o resgate [é] seu; compre para você." E eu soube que aquela [era] a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Então o meu primo Hanamel veio me visitar no pátio da guarda, exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito. Ele me disse: "Por favor, compre o meu campo em Anatote, no território de Benjamim. O direito de herança é seu, e também o direito de resgate; compre-o para você." Então eu soube que aquela era a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Então o meu primo Hanamel veio me ver no pátio da guarda, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha me dito que ele viria. Ele disse: "Por favor, compre o meu campo em Anatote, na terra de Benjamim. Você tem o direito de herdá-lo e o direito de comprá-lo de volta para a família. Compre-o para você." Então eu soube que aquela mensagem tinha vindo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: የአጎቴም ልጅ ሐናምኤል እንደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ ዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ወደ እኔ መጣ፤ እንዲህም አለኝ፦ «በብንያም ምድር በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን እባክህ ግዛ፤ የርስቱ መብት የአንተ ነውና፤ መቤዠቱም የአንተ ነው፤ ለአንተ ግዛ።» ይህም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል እንደ ሆነ አወቅኩ።
am.B: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ተናገረው የአጎቴ ልጅ ሐናምኤል በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እንዲህም አለኝ፦ «በብንያም ግዛት በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን እባክህ ግዛ። የመውረስ መብት የአንተ ነው፤ የመቤዠትም መብት የአንተ ነው፤ ለራስህ ግዛው።» ያን ጊዜ ይህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል እንደ ሆነ አወቅኩ።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ነገረኝ የአጎቴ ልጅ ሐናምኤል በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ሊያየኝ መጣ። እንዲህም አለኝ፦ «በብንያም ምድር በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን እባክህ ግዛ። እርሻውን የመውረስ መብት አለህ፤ ለቤተሰቡም መልሰህ የመግዛት መብት አለህ። ለራስህ ግዛው።» ያን ጊዜ ይህ መልእክት {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} እንደ መጣ አወቅኩ።

hi.L: और मेरे चाचा का पुत्र हनमेल {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन के अनुसार पहरे के आँगन में मेरे पास आया, और उसने मुझसे कहा, "कृपया अनातोत में, जो बिन्यामीन के देश में है, मेरा खेत मोल ले लो, क्योंकि निज भाग का अधिकार तुम्हारा [है], और छुड़ाना तुम्हारा [है]; उसे अपने लिए मोल ले लो।" तब मैंने जान लिया कि यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन [था]।
hi.B: तब, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा था, मेरा चचेरा भाई हनमेल पहरे के आँगन में मेरे पास आया। उसने मुझसे कहा, "कृपया बिन्यामीन के क्षेत्र के अनातोत में मेरा खेत मोल ले लो। उत्तराधिकार का अधिकार तुम्हारा है, और छुड़ाने का अधिकार भी; उसे अपने लिए मोल ले लो।" तब मैं जान गया कि यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन था।
hi.R: तब, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे बताया था, मेरा चचेरा भाई हनमेल पहरे के आँगन में मुझसे मिलने आया। उसने कहा, "कृपया बिन्यामीन के देश के अनातोत में मेरा खेत ख़रीद लो। उसे विरासत में पाने का अधिकार तुम्हारा है, और परिवार के लिए उसे वापस ख़रीदने का अधिकार भी तुम्हारा है। उसे अपने लिए ख़रीद लो।" तब मैं जान गया कि यह संदेश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से आया था।

ru.L: И пришёл ко мне Анамеил, сын моего дяди, по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, во двор стражи и сказал мне: «Купи же моё поле, которое в Анафофе, что в земле Вениамина, ведь за тобой право наследства и за тобой выкуп; купи [его] себе.» И я понял, что это [было] слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: И мой двоюродный брат Анамеил пришёл ко мне во двор стражи, как и сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Он сказал мне: «Прошу тебя, купи моё поле в Анафофе, в земле Вениамина. Право наследства принадлежит тебе, и право выкупа тоже; купи его себе.» Тогда я понял, что это было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Потом мой двоюродный брат Анамеил пришёл ко мне во двор стражи, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и говорил мне. Он сказал: «Пожалуйста, купи моё поле в Анафофе, в земле Вениамина. У тебя есть право унаследовать его и право выкупить его для семьи. Купи его себе.» Тогда я понял, что это слово пришло от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉のとおり、わたしのおじの子ハナムエルが、監視の庭にいるわたしのもとに来て、わたしに言った。「どうか、ベニヤミンの地のアナトトにあるわたしの畑を買ってください。相続の権利はあなたにあり、買い戻す権利もあなたにあります。あなたのために買ってください。」それでわたしは、これが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉であったと知った。
ja.B: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおり、わたしのいとこハナムエルが、監視の庭にいるわたしのところに来て言った。「どうか、ベニヤミンの地のアナトトにあるわたしの畑を買ってください。相続の権利も、買い戻しの権利も、あなたにあります。あなたのものとして買ってください。」そのとき、わたしは、これが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉であったと知った。
ja.R: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしに言われたとおり、いとこのハナムエルが、監視の庭にいるわたしのところに来ました。ハナムエルは言いました。「どうか、ベニヤミンの地のアナトトにあるわたしの畑を買ってください。あなたには、それを受け継ぐ権利があります。家族のために買い戻す権利もあります。あなたのものとして買ってください。」そのとき、わたしは、この言葉が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から来たものだとわかりました。

uk.L: І прийшов до мене Ханамеїл, син мого дядька, за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, на подвірʼя варти, і сказав мені: «Купи, прошу, моє поле, що [в] Анатоті, що [в] землі Веніямина, бо тобі право спадку, і тобі викуп; купи [його] собі». І я зрозумів, що це [було] слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Тоді мій двоюрідний брат Ханамеїл прийшов до мене на подвірʼя варти, як і сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Він сказав мені: «Купи, будь ласка, моє поле в Анатоті, у краю Веніямина. Тобі належить право спадку й право викупу; купи його собі». Тоді я зрозумів, що це було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тоді мій двоюрідний брат Ханамеїл прийшов до мене на подвірʼя варти, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} і казав мені. Він сказав: «Будь ласка, купи моє поле в Анатоті, у землі Веніямина. Ти маєш право успадкувати його і право викупити його для родини. Купи його собі». Тоді я зрозумів, що це послання було від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the right of possession: the right to hold the land as an inheritance
decisions.reason: The word means a possession held by inheritance. As the next heir, Jeremiah had the right to own the family land, and the right of redemption gave him the duty to buy it so that it did not pass outside the family (verse 7).

decisions.choice: and I knew that this was the word of the LORD: the event confirmed the word
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had heard the LORD's word in verse 7; when Hanamel came and spoke exactly as he had been told, he knew that the command to buy came from the LORD. The purchase is a sign, explained in verse 15.

decisions.choice: in the land of Benjamin: the tribal territory north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Anathoth lay in Benjamin's territory. Jeremiah had tried to go there during a pause in the siege to settle a share of property among his people, and was arrested as a deserter (37:12-14).

decisions.choice: please: a polite request
decisions.reason: The small word softens the request. Hanamel asks rather than demands; perhaps he needed the money, perhaps he wished to be rid of land in enemy hands.

decisions.choice: my cousin (B, R); just as the LORD had said (B); as the LORD had told me he would (R)
decisions.reason: "The son of my uncle" is a cousin. "According to the word of the LORD" means that it happened as the LORD said it would, and Balanced and Readable put it that way.

decisions.choice: "የርስቱ መብት" (Literal), "የመውረስ መብት" (Balanced) for the right of possession
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as the right to hold the land as an inheritance; ርስት is the inheritance word on main.

decisions.choice: चचेरा भाई (B, R)
decisions.reason: "The son of my uncle" is a cousin; Balanced and Readable say चचेरा भाई, the Hindi word for a father's brother's son, while Literal keeps चाचा का पुत्र.

decisions.choice: двоюродный брат (B, R)
decisions.reason: "The son of my uncle" is a first cousin (meaning m2 of verse 7); Balanced and Readable use the Russian word for it, Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: qeneh na' "どうか……買ってください" (every level, the polite na', m4); mishpat hayyerushah "相続の権利" (L, B), "受け継ぐ権利" (R) (m1); hagge'ullah "買い戻す権利"; va'eda' "それでわたしは……知った": the event confirmed the word (m2).
decisions.reason: ben dodi "おじの子" (L), "いとこ" (B, R), as the English.

source.text: וָֽאֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאֵ֛ת חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל בֶּן־דֹּדִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֑וֹת וָֽאֶשְׁקֲלָה־לּוֹ֙ אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַכָּֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And I bought the field from with Hanamel son of my uncle which [was] in Anathoth, and I weighed out to him the silver, seven shekels and ten the silver.

en.L: And I bought the field from Hanamel the son of my uncle, which [was] at Anathoth, and I weighed out the silver for him, seventeen shekels of silver.
en.B: So I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and I weighed out the price for him: {{units:about 7 ounces of silver|seventeen shekels of silver}}.
en.R: So I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel. I weighed out the price for him, {{units:about 7 ounces of silver|seventeen shekels of silver}}.

es.L: Y compré el campo de Hanamel, el hijo de mi tío, que [estaba] en Anatot, y le pesé la plata, diecisiete siclos de plata.
es.B: Así que le compré a mi primo Hanamel el campo de Anatot, y le pesé el precio: {{units:unos 200 gramos de plata|diecisiete siclos de plata}}.
es.R: Así que le compré a mi primo Hanamel el campo de Anatot. Le pesé el precio, {{units:unos 200 gramos de plata|diecisiete siclos de plata}}.

fr.L: Et j’achetai le champ de Hanaméel, le fils de mon oncle, qui [était] à Anatoth, et je lui pesai l’argent, dix-sept sicles d’argent.
fr.B: J’achetai donc à mon cousin Hanaméel le champ d’Anatoth, et je lui pesai le prix : {{units:environ 200 grammes d’argent|dix-sept sicles d’argent}}.
fr.R: J’ai donc acheté à mon cousin Hanaméel le champ d’Anatoth. Je lui ai pesé le prix, {{units:environ 200 grammes d’argent|dix-sept sicles d’argent}}.

sw.L: Nami nikalinunua shamba lile lililo Anathothi kutoka kwa Hanameli mwana wa baba yangu mdogo, nikampimia fedha, shekeli kumi na saba za fedha.
sw.B: Basi nililinunua shamba lililoko Anathothi kutoka kwa binamu yangu Hanameli, nikampimia bei yake: {{units:karibu gramu 200 za fedha|shekeli kumi na saba za fedha}}.
sw.R: Basi nililinunua shamba lililoko Anathothi kutoka kwa binamu yangu Hanameli. Nikampimia bei yake, {{units:karibu gramu 200 za fedha|shekeli kumi na saba za fedha}}.

vi.L: Tôi mua cánh đồng ở A-na-tốt của Ha-na-mên con trai chú tôi, và tôi cân bạc cho anh ấy, mười bảy siếc-lơ bạc.
vi.B: Vậy tôi mua cánh đồng ở A-na-tốt của Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi, và cân tiền trả cho anh ấy: {{units:khoảng 200 gam bạc|mười bảy siếc-lơ bạc}}.
vi.R: Vậy tôi mua cánh đồng ở A-na-tốt của Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi. Tôi cân tiền trả cho anh ấy, {{units:khoảng 200 gam bạc|mười bảy siếc-lơ bạc}}.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 아나돗에 있는 그 밭을 내 삼촌의 아들 하나멜에게서 사고, 그에게 은을, 은 17세겔을 달아 주었다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 내 사촌 하나멜에게서 아나돗에 있는 그 밭을 사고, 그 값으로 {{units:은 약 200그램|은 17세겔}}을 달아 주었다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 내 사촌 하나멜에게서 아나돗에 있는 그 밭을 샀다. 나는 그 값으로 {{units:은 약 200그램|은 17세겔}}을 저울에 달아 주었다.

pt.L: E eu comprei o campo de Hanamel, filho do meu tio, que [ficava] em Anatote, e pesei para ele a prata, dezessete siclos de prata.
pt.B: Então comprei de Hanamel, meu primo, o campo de Anatote, e pesei para ele o preço: {{units:cerca de 200 gramas de prata|dezessete siclos de prata}}.
pt.R: Então comprei o campo de Anatote do meu primo Hanamel. Pesei o preço para ele: {{units:cerca de 200 gramas de prata|dezessete siclos de prata}}.

am.L: በዓናቶት ያለውንም እርሻ ከአጎቴ ልጅ ከሐናምኤል ገዛሁ፤ ብሩንም መዘንኩለት፤ አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብር።
am.B: ስለዚህ በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻ ከአጎቴ ልጅ ከሐናምኤል ገዛሁ፤ ዋጋውንም {{units:200 ግራም ያህል ብር|አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብር}} መዝኜ ሰጠሁት።
am.R: ስለዚህ በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻ ከአጎቴ ልጅ ከሐናምኤል ገዛሁ። ዋጋውን {{units:200 ግራም ያህል ብር|አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብር}} መዝኜ ሰጠሁት።

hi.L: तब मैंने अपने चाचा के पुत्र हनमेल से वह खेत, जो अनातोत में [था], मोल ले लिया, और मैंने उसके लिए चाँदी तौल दी, सत्रह शेकेल चाँदी।
hi.B: इस प्रकार मैंने अपने चचेरे भाई हनमेल से अनातोत का वह खेत मोल ले लिया, और उसके लिए दाम तौल दिया: {{units:लगभग 200 ग्राम चाँदी|सत्रह शेकेल चाँदी}}।
hi.R: तो मैंने अपने चचेरे भाई हनमेल से अनातोत का खेत ख़रीद लिया। मैंने उसके लिए दाम तौलकर दिया, {{units:लगभग 200 ग्राम चाँदी|सत्रह शेकेल चाँदी}}।

ru.L: И купил я поле у Анамеила, сына моего дяди, которое в Анафофе, и отвесил ему серебро, семнадцать сиклей серебра.
ru.B: Так я купил у моего двоюродного брата Анамеила поле в Анафофе и отвесил ему плату: {{units:около 200 граммов серебра|семнадцать сиклей серебра}}.
ru.R: Так я купил поле в Анафофе у своего двоюродного брата Анамеила. Я отвесил ему плату — {{units:около 200 граммов серебра|семнадцать сиклей серебра}}.

ja.L: わたしは、わたしのおじの子ハナムエルから、アナトトにあるその畑を買い、彼に銀を量って渡した。銀十七シェケルであった。
ja.B: わたしは、いとこハナムエルから、アナトトにあるその畑を買い、その代金を量って渡した。{{units:銀約200グラム|銀十七シェケル}}である。
ja.R: わたしは、いとこのハナムエルから、アナトトの畑を買いました。わたしは代金を量って、彼に渡しました。{{units:銀約200グラム|銀十七シェケル}}でした。

uk.L: І я купив поле в Ханамеїла, сина мого дядька, що [в] Анатоті, і відважив йому срібло, сімнадцять шекелів срібла.
uk.B: Тож я купив поле в Анатоті в мого двоюрідного брата Ханамеїла і відважив йому плату: {{units:близько 200 грамів срібла|сімнадцять шекелів срібла}}.
uk.R: Тож я купив поле в Анатоті в мого двоюрідного брата Ханамеїла. Я відважив йому плату, {{units:близько 200 грамів срібла|сімнадцять шекелів срібла}}.

decisions.choice: I weighed out the silver: payment by weight, before coins were used
decisions.reason: Money in Judah was silver weighed on scales (verse 10; Genesis 23:16). The shekel was a weight, about two-fifths of an ounce, not a coin. Seventeen shekels is a modest sum, but the size of the field is not given, and land near a besieged city in enemy hands could not have fetched much.

decisions.choice: seven shekels and ten: seventeen
decisions.reason: Hebrew can put the units before the tens; "seven shekels and ten" is seventeen shekels.

decisions.choice: about 7 ounces of silver (B, R; original unit as the alternative)
decisions.reason: Seventeen shekels at about two-fifths of an ounce each is about 7 ounces. Literal keeps the Hebrew unit; Balanced and Readable give the modern measure with the shekel as the setting's alternative.

decisions.choice: the price (B, R)
decisions.reason: The first "silver" in the verse is the payment; Balanced and Readable say "price" so that "silver" is not said twice.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 200 gramos de plata|diecisiete siclos de plata}}
decisions.reason: Seventeen shekels at 11.5 g each, rounded as the English rounds ("about 7 ounces"); the original unit is the alternative, and Literal keeps "siclos".

decisions.choice: karibu gramu 200 za fedha
alternatives: shekeli kumi na saba za fedha
decisions.reason: Swahili gives metric weight by default with the shekels as the alternative, as the Swahili style sets (the English converts to ounces); Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: "environ 200 grammes d'argent", with "dix-sept sicles d'argent" as the units alternative
decisions.reason: French takes the metric measure by default, as the style guide sets: seventeen shekels at about 11.5 g each come to about 200 g. Literal keeps the Hebrew unit.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 200 gam bạc", with "mười bảy siếc-lơ bạc" as the units alternative
decisions.reason: Vietnamese settings give metric by default and the original unit as the alternative (style guide, section 7), unlike the English US units; seventeen shekels of about 11.5 g each is close to 200 g. Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: "{{units:은 약 200그램|은 17세겔}}"
decisions.reason: As the style guide and terms note: metric by default, the original unit as the alternative, in the form "약 X"; a shekel is about 11.4 grams, so 17 shekels is about 194 grams. The English converts to ounces; Literal keeps "17세겔", as the English Literal keeps "seventeen shekels".

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 200 gramas de prata|dezessete siclos de prata}}
decisions.reason: Portuguese gives the metric weight by default, where the English gives ounces: seventeen shekels at 11.5 grams each, as the Old Testament terms set the shekel, is about 200 grams. The alternative is the Hebrew unit, "siclo", which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: {{units:200 ግራም ያህል ብር|አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብር}}; Literal keeps "አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብር"
alternatives: US units, as in the English
decisions.reason: Amharic gives metric measures by default with the original unit as the alternative; seventeen shekels of about 11.5 grams come to about 195 grams.

decisions.choice: {{units:близько 200 грамів срібла|сімнадцять шекелів срібла}}: metric by default, the shekels as the alternative
decisions.reason: Ukrainian readers measure in grams; seventeen shekels at 11.5 g is about 195 g, rounded as the English rounds its ounces. Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: लगभग 200 ग्राम चाँदी (default); सत्रह शेकेल चाँदी (alternative)
decisions.reason: Hindi readers measure in grams, so the units setting gives the metric weight by default (17 shekels at 11.5 g is about 195 g) where the English gives ounces, with the shekel as the alternative; Literal keeps the shekel.

decisions.choice: около 200 граммов серебра (default); семнадцать сиклей серебра (alternative)
decisions.reason: The units setting is metric by default in Russian, where the English default gives ounces. Seventeen shekels of about 11.4 grams each weigh about 200 grams. Literal keeps the sikl, the form used for the shekel in this translation.

decisions.choice: shiv'ah sheqalim va'asarah hakkasef "銀十七シェケル" (L); B, R a units span "{{units:銀約200グラム|銀十七シェケル}}", metric by default with the original as the alternative (the English has US ounces), at about 11.4 grams to the shekel as 1SA / 1KI; L keeps the unit. Payment by weight (m1).
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7 units; the OT notes' shekel values.

source.text: וָאֶכְתֹּ֤ב בַּסֵּ֨פֶר֙ וָֽאֶחְתֹּ֔ם וָאָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I wrote in the deed and I sealed, and I caused to witness witnesses, and I weighed out the silver on scales.

en.L: And I wrote in the deed and sealed [it], and I had witnesses attest [it], and I weighed out the silver on the scales.
en.B: I signed the deed and sealed it, had it witnessed, and weighed the silver on scales.
en.R: I signed the deed and sealed it, and I had witnesses sign it too. Then I weighed out the silver on a scale.

es.L: Y escribí en la escritura y [la] sellé, e hice que testigos [la] certificaran, y pesé la plata en la balanza.
es.B: Firmé la escritura y la sellé, la hice certificar por testigos y pesé la plata en la balanza.
es.R: Firmé la escritura y la sellé, e hice que unos testigos también la firmaran. Después pesé la plata en una balanza.

fr.L: Et j’écrivis dans l’acte et je [le] scellai, et je [le] fis attester par des témoins, et je pesai l’argent sur la balance.
fr.B: Je signai l’acte et le scellai, je le fis attester par des témoins et je pesai l’argent sur une balance.
fr.R: J’ai signé l’acte et je l’ai scellé, et j’ai fait signer des témoins. Puis j’ai pesé l’argent sur une balance.

sw.L: Nikaandika katika hati na kuitia muhuri, nikawashuhudisha mashahidi, nikaipima fedha katika mizani.
sw.B: Niliiandika hati na kuitia muhuri, nikawaweka mashahidi waishuhudie, nikaipima fedha katika mizani.
sw.R: Niliiandika hati na kuitia muhuri, nikawaambia mashahidi waitie sahihi pia. Kisha nikaipima fedha katika mizani.

vi.L: Tôi viết vào khế ước và đóng ấn, rồi mời các nhân chứng làm chứng, và tôi cân bạc trên cân.
vi.B: Tôi ký khế ước, đóng ấn, nhờ nhân chứng làm chứng, rồi cân bạc trên cân.
vi.R: Tôi ký vào khế ước và đóng ấn, rồi nhờ các nhân chứng cùng ký tên. Sau đó tôi cân bạc trên cân.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 증서에 기록하고 봉인한 뒤 증인들을 세워 증언하게 하고, 저울에 은을 달아 주었다.
ko.B: 나는 증서에 서명하고 봉인한 다음, 증인들을 세우고, 은을 저울에 달아 주었다.
ko.R: 나는 증서에 서명하고 봉인했다. 그리고 증인들에게도 서명하게 했다. 그런 다음 은을 저울에 달아 주었다.

pt.L: E escrevi na escritura e [a] selei, e fiz testemunhas testemunharem, e pesei a prata na balança.
pt.B: Assinei a escritura e a selei, fiz com que fosse testemunhada e pesei a prata na balança.
pt.R: Assinei a escritura e a selei. Também pedi que testemunhas a assinassem. Depois pesei a prata numa balança.

am.L: በውሉም ላይ ጻፍኩ፤ አተምኩትም፤ ምስክሮችንም አስመሰከርኩ፤ ብሩንም በሚዛን መዘንኩ።
am.B: በውሉ ላይ ፈረምኩ፤ አተምኩትም፤ በምስክሮችም አስመሰከርኩ፤ ብሩንም በሚዛን መዘንኩ።
am.R: በውሉ ላይ ፈረምኩ፤ አተምኩትም፤ ምስክሮችም እንዲፈርሙበት አደረግኩ። ከዚያም ብሩን በሚዛን መዘንኩ።

hi.L: और मैंने दस्तावेज़ में लिखा और [उस पर] मुहर लगाई, और गवाहों से गवाही दिलवाई, और तराज़ू पर चाँदी तौली।
hi.B: मैंने दस्तावेज़ पर हस्ताक्षर करके उस पर मुहर लगाई, उसकी गवाही करवाई, और तराज़ू पर चाँदी तौली।
hi.R: मैंने दस्तावेज़ पर हस्ताक्षर किए और उस पर मुहर लगाई। मैंने गवाहों से भी उस पर हस्ताक्षर करवाए। फिर मैंने तराज़ू पर चाँदी तौलकर दी।

ru.L: И написал я в купчей, и запечатал [её], и взял свидетелей в свидетели, и отвесил серебро на весах.
ru.B: Я подписал купчую, запечатал её, заверил её у свидетелей и отвесил серебро на весах.
ru.R: Я подписал купчую и запечатал её. Свидетели тоже подписали её. Потом я отвесил серебро на весах.

ja.L: わたしは証書に書き記して封印し、証人を立て、銀をはかりで量った。
ja.B: わたしは証書に署名して封印し、証人に立ち会わせ、銀をはかりで量った。
ja.R: わたしは証書に名前を書いて封印し、証人たちにも署名してもらいました。それから、はかりで銀を量りました。

uk.L: І я написав у грамоті й запечатав [її], і взяв свідків, і відважив срібло на терезах.
uk.B: Я підписав купчу й запечатав її, засвідчив її при свідках і відважив срібло на терезах.
uk.R: Я підписав купчу й запечатав її, а ще дав свідкам її підписати. Тоді я відважив срібло на терезах.

decisions.choice: I wrote in the deed: signed it, putting his name to it
decisions.reason: The verb is "wrote", with "in the deed". The witnesses "wrote in the deed" too (verse 12), which shows that signing is meant: each party put his name or mark on the document. The deed itself may have been drawn up by a scribe.

decisions.choice: sealed it and had witnesses: the legal steps of a land sale
decisions.reason: A contract for land was written, sealed and witnessed, and the payment weighed in front of the witnesses, so that the sale could be proved later (verse 44). Sealing meant rolling or folding the document and closing it with clay or wax pressed with a seal.

decisions.choice: had witnesses attest it (L); had it witnessed (B); had witnesses sign it (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "I caused witnesses to witness" repeats one root. Each level says what the witnesses did in its own way; Readable says "sign" because verse 12 says they wrote on the deed.

decisions.choice: "khế ước" (deed)
decisions.reason: "Khế ước" is the established word for a written contract of sale, used for the deed through verses 10-16 and 44.

decisions.choice: escrevi na escritura (L); assinei a escritura (B, R)
decisions.reason: "A escritura" is the Portuguese legal word for a deed of sale of land, so the record of the purchase reads as the legal act it was (m2). Literal keeps the Hebrew "wrote in" the deed; Balanced and Readable say "assinei", as the English says "signed" (m1).

decisions.choice: "ውል" for the deed of sale
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the ordinary word for a written document; for a land sale the living Amharic word is ውል (contract). "የግዢ ውል" is the deed of purchase.

decisions.choice: दस्तावेज़; ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ (verses 10-16, 44)
decisions.reason: The deed (sefer) is दस्तावेज़ at every level, the ordinary word for a legal document; the deed of purchase is ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़, its two copies मुहरबंद प्रति and खुली प्रति. Balanced and Readable say हस्ताक्षर करना for writing one's name in it.

decisions.choice: купчая; взял свидетелей в свидетели (L); заверил у свидетелей (B); свидетели тоже подписали (R)
decisions.reason: "Купчая" is the Russian word for a deed of sale. The Hebrew "I caused witnesses to witness" repeats one root, which Literal keeps; Balanced and Readable say what the witnesses did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: sefer "証書" (the deed; "手紙" in 29:1 for a letter), 'ekhtov "書き記して" (L), "署名して" (B), "名前を書いて" (R) (m1); 'echtom "封印し"; va'a'ed 'edim "証人を立て" (L), "証人に立ち会わせ" (B), "証人たちにも署名してもらいました" (R) (m2).
decisions.reason: As the English levels.

source.text: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת־הֶֽחָת֛וּם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה וְהַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַגָּלֽוּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I took the deed of the purchase, the sealed [one], the terms and the conditions, and the open [one].

en.L: And I took the deed of the purchase, the sealed [copy], the terms and the conditions, and the open [copy].
en.B: Then I took the deed of purchase, both the sealed copy, containing the terms and conditions, and the open copy.
en.R: Then I took the two copies of the deed of purchase. One copy, which had the terms and conditions of the sale, was sealed. The other copy was left open.

es.L: Y tomé la escritura de la compra, la [copia] sellada, con los términos y las condiciones, y la [copia] abierta.
es.B: Luego tomé la escritura de compra, tanto la copia sellada, que contenía los términos y las condiciones, como la copia abierta.
es.R: Luego tomé las dos copias de la escritura de compra. Una copia, que tenía los términos y las condiciones de la venta, estaba sellada. La otra copia quedó abierta.

fr.L: Et je pris l’acte d’achat, celui qui était scellé, les termes et les conditions, et celui qui était ouvert.
fr.B: Puis je pris l’acte d’achat, l’exemplaire scellé, qui contenait les termes et les conditions, et l’exemplaire ouvert.
fr.R: Puis j’ai pris les deux exemplaires de l’acte d’achat. Un exemplaire, qui contenait les termes et les conditions de la vente, était scellé. L’autre exemplaire était resté ouvert.

sw.L: Nikaichukua hati ya ununuzi, ile iliyotiwa muhuri, yenye masharti na kanuni, na ile iliyo wazi.
sw.B: Kisha nikaichukua hati ya ununuzi, nakala iliyotiwa muhuri, yenye masharti na kanuni, pamoja na nakala iliyo wazi.
sw.R: Kisha nikazichukua nakala mbili za hati ya ununuzi. Nakala moja, iliyokuwa na masharti na kanuni za mauzo, ilitiwa muhuri. Nakala nyingine iliachwa wazi.

vi.L: Rồi tôi lấy khế ước mua bán, bản đã đóng ấn, [có] các điều khoản và điều kiện, cùng bản để mở.
vi.B: Rồi tôi lấy khế ước mua bán, cả bản đã đóng ấn có ghi các điều khoản và điều kiện, lẫn bản để mở.
vi.R: Rồi tôi lấy hai bản khế ước mua bán. Một bản ghi các điều khoản và điều kiện của việc mua bán thì được đóng ấn. Bản kia được để mở.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 매매 증서, 곧 조항과 조건이 [적힌] 봉인한 [사본]과 봉인하지 않은 [사본]을 가져왔다.
ko.B: 그런 다음 나는 매매 증서를 가져왔다. 하나는 조항과 조건이 적힌 봉인한 사본이고, 다른 하나는 봉인하지 않은 사본이었다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 나는 매매 증서 두 장을 가져왔다. 한 장에는 매매 조건이 적혀 있었는데, 그것은 봉인되어 있었다. 다른 한 장은 봉인하지 않은 채로 두었다.

pt.L: E tomei a escritura da compra, a selada, os termos e as condições, e a aberta.
pt.B: Depois peguei a escritura de compra, tanto a cópia selada, com os termos e as condições, como a cópia aberta.
pt.R: Depois peguei as duas cópias da escritura de compra. Uma cópia, que tinha os termos e as condições da venda, estava selada. A outra cópia ficou aberta.

am.L: የግዢውንም ውል፣ ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን የያዘውን የታተመውን [ቅጂ]፣ የተከፈተውንም [ቅጂ] ወሰድኩ።
am.B: ከዚያም የግዢውን ውል፣ ደንቡንና ውሉን የያዘውን የታተመውን ቅጂና የተከፈተውን ቅጂ ወሰድኩ።
am.R: ከዚያም የግዢውን ውል ሁለቱን ቅጂዎች ወሰድኩ። የሽያጩን ደንብና ውል የያዘው አንዱ ቅጂ ታትሞ ነበር፤ ሌላው ቅጂ ግን ክፍት ሆኖ ቀረ።

hi.L: और मैंने ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ लिया, मुहरबंद [प्रति], जिसमें शर्तें और नियम [थे], और खुली [प्रति]।
hi.B: फिर मैंने ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ लिया, उसकी मुहरबंद प्रति भी, जिसमें शर्तें और नियम लिखे थे, और खुली प्रति भी।
hi.R: फिर मैंने ख़रीद के दस्तावेज़ की दोनों प्रतियाँ लीं। एक प्रति पर, जिसमें सौदे की शर्तें और नियम लिखे थे, मुहर लगी थी। दूसरी प्रति खुली रखी गई थी।

ru.L: И взял я купчую, запечатанную, [где] условия и правила, и открытую.
ru.B: Потом я взял купчую — и запечатанный экземпляр, где были записаны условия сделки, и открытый.
ru.R: Потом я взял оба экземпляра купчей. Один из них, где были записаны условия продажи, был запечатан. Другой оставался открытым.

ja.L: わたしは購入の証書、すなわち、条項と規定[が記され]封印されたものと、開いたままのものとを取った。
ja.B: それから、わたしは購入の証書を取った。条項と規定が記されて封印された写しと、開いたままの写しである。
ja.R: それから、わたしは購入の証書の二通の写しを取りました。一通には売買の条件が書かれていて、封印されていました。もう一通は、封印されずに開いたままでした。

uk.L: І я взяв купчу грамоту, запечатану, [з] умовами й постановами, і відкриту.
uk.B: Тоді я взяв купчу, і запечатаний примірник з умовами й постановами, і відкритий.
uk.R: Тоді я взяв обидва примірники купчої. Один примірник, де були записані умови продажу, був запечатаний. Другий залишили відкритим.

decisions.choice: the sealed copy and the open copy: a deed written twice
decisions.reason: Documents of the time were often written twice, sometimes on one sheet. One copy was rolled up and sealed so that no one could change it; the other was left open so that it could be read without breaking the seals. If the open copy was ever disputed, the sealed one could be opened in front of witnesses. Verse 14 calls them two deeds.

decisions.choice: the terms and the conditions: what the sealed copy contained
alternatives: the sealed copy, sealed according to the law and its rules
decisions.reason: The two words stand between "the sealed one" and "the open one". They are taken as saying what the sealed copy held: the full details of the sale. They might instead describe the deed as a whole, or the legal formulas by which it was sealed.

decisions.choice: terms and conditions: the words for command and statute used of a contract
decisions.reason: The two words are the usual ones for a commandment and a statute in the Law. Here they are used of the legal terms of a business document.

decisions.choice: copy (all levels); two copies (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the sealed" and "the open"; English needs a noun, bracketed at Literal. Readable says there were two copies.

decisions.choice: "사본" ([사본] at Literal)
decisions.reason: The deed was written twice, one copy sealed and one open (meaning decision m1); Korean needs a noun for "the sealed one" and "the open one", bracketed at Literal as the English brackets "copy".

decisions.choice: a selada ... a aberta (L)
decisions.reason: Portuguese adjectives can stand alone after "a", agreeing with "escritura", so Literal needs no bracketed noun where the English brackets "copy"; Balanced and Readable say "cópia", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን" for the terms and the conditions at Literal; "ደንቡንና ውሉን" at Balanced
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes the words for command and statute used of a contract; Literal keeps the two law words, Balanced says what they are in a sale.

decisions.choice: [где] (L); экземпляр (B, R); оба экземпляра (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "the sealed" and "the open"; Russian adjectives can stand alone with "купчая", so Literal needs only the bracketed "где" for the terms. Balanced and Readable say there were two copies of one deed (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: sefer hammiqnah "購入の証書"; hechatum "封印されたもの" (L), "封印された写し" (B, R), hegaluy "開いたままのもの" (L), "開いたままの写し" (B, R), a deed written twice (m1); hammitsvah vehachuqqim "条項と規定" (L, B), "売買の条件" (R) (m2, uncertain; m3).
decisions.reason: "写し" at B, R for the English "copy".

source.text: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְעֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל דֹּדִ֔י וּלְעֵינֵי֙ הָֽעֵדִ֔ים הַכֹּתְבִ֖ים בְּסֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה לְעֵינֵי֙ כָּל־הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I gave the deed of the purchase to Baruch son of Neriah son of Mahseiah to [the] eyes of Hanamel my uncle and to [the] eyes of the witnesses, the [ones] writing in [the] deed of the purchase, to [the] eyes of all the Judeans, the [ones] sitting in [the] courtyard of the guard.

en.L: And I gave the deed of the purchase to Baruch son of Neriah son of Mahseiah before the eyes of Hanamel [son of] my uncle, and before the eyes of the witnesses who wrote in the deed of the purchase, before the eyes of all the Judeans who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
en.B: I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah, while my cousin Hanamel looked on, along with the witnesses who had signed the deed and all the Judeans who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
en.R: I gave the deed to Baruch son of Neriah and grandson of Mahseiah. My cousin Hanamel saw me do it. So did the witnesses who had signed the deed, and all the men of Judah who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

es.L: Y di la escritura de la compra a Baruc hijo de Nerías, hijo de Mahseías, ante los ojos de Hanamel, [el hijo de] mi tío, y ante los ojos de los testigos que escribieron en la escritura de la compra, ante los ojos de todos los judíos que estaban sentados en el patio de la guardia.
es.B: Le di la escritura de compra a Baruc hijo de Nerías, hijo de Mahseías, en presencia de mi primo Hanamel y de los testigos que habían firmado la escritura, y de todos los judíos que estaban sentados en el patio de la guardia.
es.R: Le di la escritura a Baruc, hijo de Nerías y nieto de Mahseías. Mi primo Hanamel me vio hacerlo. También lo vieron los testigos que habían firmado la escritura, y todos los hombres de Judá que estaban sentados en el patio de la guardia.

fr.L: Et je remis l’acte d’achat à Baruch fils de Nériya, fils de Mahséya, sous les yeux de Hanaméel, [le fils de] mon oncle, et sous les yeux des témoins qui avaient écrit dans l’acte d’achat, sous les yeux de tous les Judéens qui étaient assis dans la cour de la garde.
fr.B: Je remis l’acte d’achat à Baruch fils de Nériya, fils de Mahséya, sous les yeux de mon cousin Hanaméel, des témoins qui avaient signé l’acte, et de tous les Judéens qui étaient assis dans la cour de la garde.
fr.R: J’ai donné l’acte à Baruch, fils de Nériya et petit-fils de Mahséya. Mon cousin Hanaméel m’a vu le faire. Les témoins qui avaient signé l’acte l’ont vu aussi, ainsi que tous les hommes de Juda qui étaient assis dans la cour de la garde.

sw.L: Nikampa Baruku mwana wa Neria mwana wa Mahseya hati ya ununuzi mbele ya macho ya Hanameli [mwana wa] baba yangu mdogo, na mbele ya macho ya mashahidi walioandika katika hati ya ununuzi, mbele ya macho ya Wayahudi wote waliokuwa wameketi katika ua wa walinzi.
sw.B: Nilimpa Baruku mwana wa Neria, mwana wa Mahseya, hati ya ununuzi, binamu yangu Hanameli akitazama, pamoja na mashahidi waliokuwa wameitia sahihi hati hiyo na Wayahudi wote waliokuwa wameketi katika ua wa walinzi.
sw.R: Nilimpa Baruku mwana wa Neria na mjukuu wa Mahseya hati hiyo. Binamu yangu Hanameli aliniona nikifanya hivyo. Vivyo hivyo mashahidi waliokuwa wameitia sahihi hati hiyo, na watu wote wa Yuda waliokuwa wameketi katika ua wa walinzi.

vi.L: Tôi trao khế ước mua bán cho Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, con trai Mạc-sê-gia, trước mắt Ha-na-mên [con trai] chú tôi, trước mắt các nhân chứng đã ký tên vào khế ước mua bán, và trước mắt mọi người Giu-đa đang ngồi trong sân lính canh.
vi.B: Tôi trao khế ước mua bán cho Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, cháu Mạc-sê-gia, trước mặt Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi, cùng các nhân chứng đã ký tên vào khế ước và mọi người Giu-đa đang ngồi trong sân lính canh.
vi.R: Tôi trao khế ước cho Ba-rúc, con trai Nê-ri-gia, cháu Mạc-sê-gia. Ha-na-mên, anh em họ của tôi, thấy tôi làm điều đó. Các nhân chứng đã ký tên vào khế ước và mọi người Giu-đa đang ngồi trong sân lính canh cũng thấy.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그 매매 증서를 마세야의 손자 네리야의 아들 바룩에게 주었다. 내 삼촌의 [아들] 하나멜과 매매 증서에 서명한 증인들과 경비대 뜰에 앉아 있던 모든 유다 사람이 보는 앞에서 [주었다].
ko.B: 나는 그 매매 증서를 마세야의 손자요 네리야의 아들인 바룩에게 주었다. 내 사촌 하나멜과 증서에 서명한 증인들과 경비대 뜰에 앉아 있던 모든 유다 사람이 그것을 지켜보았다.
ko.R: 나는 그 증서를 네리야의 아들이요 마세야의 손자인 바룩에게 주었다. 내 사촌 하나멜이 그것을 보았다. 증서에 서명한 증인들과 경비대 뜰에 앉아 있던 유다 사람들도 모두 그것을 보았다.

pt.L: E dei a escritura da compra a Baruque, filho de Nerias, filho de Maaseias, diante dos olhos de Hanamel, [filho do] meu tio, e diante dos olhos das testemunhas que escreveram na escritura da compra, diante dos olhos de todos os judeus que estavam sentados no pátio da guarda.
pt.B: Dei a escritura de compra a Baruque, filho de Nerias, filho de Maaseias, enquanto o meu primo Hanamel olhava, junto com as testemunhas que tinham assinado a escritura e todos os judeus que estavam sentados no pátio da guarda.
pt.R: Dei a escritura a Baruque, filho de Nerias e neto de Maaseias. O meu primo Hanamel me viu fazer isso. As testemunhas que tinham assinado a escritura também viram, e todos os homens de Judá que estavam sentados no pátio da guarda.

am.L: የግዢውንም ውል በአጎቴ [ልጅ] በሐናምኤል ዓይን ፊት፣ በግዢውም ውል ላይ በጻፉት ምስክሮች ዓይን ፊት፣ በዘበኞቹም አደባባይ በተቀመጡት አይሁድ ሁሉ ዓይን ፊት ለመሕሤያ ልጅ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት።
am.B: የግዢውን ውል ለመሕሤያ ልጅ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት፤ ይህን ያደረግኩት የአጎቴ ልጅ ሐናምኤል፣ በውሉ ላይ የፈረሙት ምስክሮችና በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ተቀምጠው የነበሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ እያዩ ነው።
am.R: ውሉን የመሕሤያ የልጅ ልጅ ለሆነው ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት። የአጎቴ ልጅ ሐናምኤል ይህን ሳደርግ አየ። በውሉ ላይ የፈረሙት ምስክሮችና በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ተቀምጠው የነበሩት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ ደግሞ አዩ።

hi.L: और मैंने ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ महसेयाह के पुत्र नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक को, अपने चाचा [के पुत्र] हनमेल की आँखों के सामने, और ख़रीद के दस्तावेज़ में लिखनेवाले गवाहों की आँखों के सामने, और पहरे के आँगन में बैठे हुए सब यहूदियों की आँखों के सामने दिया।
hi.B: मैंने ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ महसेयाह के पोते, नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक को दिया। उस समय मेरा चचेरा भाई हनमेल देख रहा था, और वे गवाह भी जिन्होंने दस्तावेज़ पर हस्ताक्षर किए थे, और पहरे के आँगन में बैठे हुए सब यहूदी भी।
hi.R: मैंने वह दस्तावेज़ बारूक को दिया, जो नेरिय्याह का बेटा और महसेयाह का पोता था। मेरे चचेरे भाई हनमेल ने मुझे ऐसा करते देखा। उन गवाहों ने भी देखा जिन्होंने दस्तावेज़ पर हस्ताक्षर किए थे, और यहूदा के उन सब पुरुषों ने भी जो पहरे के आँगन में बैठे थे।

ru.L: И отдал я купчую Варуху, сыну Нирии, сына Махсеи, на глазах Анамеила, [сына] моего дяди, и на глазах свидетелей, подписавших купчую, на глазах всех иудеев, сидевших во дворе стражи.
ru.B: Я отдал купчую Варуху, сыну Нирии, сына Махсеи, у всех на виду: при моём двоюродном брате Анамеиле, при свидетелях, которые подписали купчую, и при всех иудеях, которые сидели во дворе стражи.
ru.R: Я отдал купчую Варуху, сыну Нирии и внуку Махсеи. Мой двоюродный брат Анамеил видел, как я это сделал. Это видели и свидетели, которые подписали купчую, и все жители Иуды, которые сидели во дворе стражи.

ja.L: そして、わたしはその購入の証書を、マフセヤの子ネリヤの子バルクに渡した。わたしのおじの[子]ハナムエルの目の前、購入の証書に書き記した証人たちの目の前、監視の庭に座っていたすべてのユダの人々の目の前でのことである。
ja.B: わたしはその購入の証書を、マフセヤの子ネリヤの子バルクに渡した。いとこハナムエルと、証書に署名した証人たちと、監視の庭に座っていたユダの人々が皆、それを見ていた。
ja.R: わたしは、その証書を、ネリヤの息子でマフセヤの孫であるバルクに渡しました。いとこのハナムエルが、それを見ていました。証書に署名した証人たちも、監視の庭に座っていたユダの人々もみな、見ていました。

uk.L: І я дав купчу грамоту Варухові, синові Нерії, сина Махсеї, на очах Ханамеїла, [сина] мого дядька, і на очах свідків, які підписалися на купчій грамоті, на очах усіх юдеїв, що сиділи на подвірʼї варти.
uk.B: Я віддав купчу Варухові, синові Нерії, сина Махсеї, на очах у мого двоюрідного брата Ханамеїла, свідків, що підписали купчу, і всіх юдеїв, які сиділи на подвірʼї варти.
uk.R: Я віддав купчу Варухові, синові Нерії й онукові Махсеї. Мій двоюрідний брат Ханамеїл бачив це. Бачили й свідки, що підписали купчу, і всі чоловіки з Юдеї, які сиділи на подвірʼї варти.

decisions.choice: Baruch son of Neriah: Jeremiah's scribe and companion
decisions.reason: Baruch is named here for the first time in the book's order. He wrote down Jeremiah's words and read them in the temple (36:4-10, 32), went with him into Egypt (43:6) and received a word of his own (45:1-5). A scribe was the right person to keep legal documents.

decisions.choice: Hanamel my uncle: read as "the son of my uncle", as in verses 8 and 9
alternatives: Hanamel my uncle, as the Hebrew stands
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here says "Hanamel my uncle", but Hanamel is the son of Jeremiah's uncle Shallum (verses 7-9). The word "son of" may have dropped out in copying, or the phrase may be a short way of naming the family relationship. Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek translation read "the son of my uncle".

decisions.choice: before the eyes of: in the sight of, as witnesses
decisions.reason: The phrase comes three times: the sale was public, done in front of the seller, the signing witnesses and all who were present, so that no one could later deny it.

decisions.choice: the Judeans: the people of Judah present in the courtyard
decisions.reason: The word names people of Judah; here those who were in the courtyard of the guard, perhaps guards, other prisoners or visitors.

decisions.choice: [son of] my uncle (L); my cousin (B, R)
decisions.reason: Following m2, Literal brackets the words "son of" and Balanced and Readable say "cousin". Readable says "grandson of Mahseiah" for the second "son of", and "men of Judah" for those sitting in the courtyard.

decisions.choice: Baruc hijo de Nerías, hijo de Mahseías
decisions.reason: The form the terms note sets ("Baruc hijo de Nerías"); "Mahseías" keeps the Hebrew name apart from "Maasías" (Maaseiah).

decisions.choice: Baruku mwana wa Neria
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili form of Baruch's name; Mahseiah as "Mahseya".

decisions.choice: "Baruch fils de Nériya"
decisions.reason: The French form the terms note sets for Jeremiah's scribe.

decisions.choice: "Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia"; "Mạc-sê-gia"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for Baruch son of Neriah, new in Vietnamese (Luke 3:27's "Nê-ri" is another name); "Mạc-sê-gia" is new too.

decisions.choice: "네리야의 아들 바룩"; "마세야"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for Baruch son of Neriah; Mahseiah is "마세야", kept apart from Maaseiah ("마아세야") of 21:1 and 29:21.

decisions.choice: Baruque, filho de Nerias; os judeus (L, B), os homens de Judá (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Jeremiah's scribe (m1) is "Baruque, filho de Nerias", the usual Brazilian form, with the final vowel Portuguese adds, as in "Calebe" (36:4; 43:3; 45:1). The Judeans are "os judeus" (L, B), the people of Judah, as 2 Kings 25:25 has them in Portuguese ("judaítas" is rare in Portuguese), here and wherever they return (40:11; 41:3 and after), and "os homens de Judá" at Readable, as the English Readable says.

decisions.choice: "የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ" (terms list) and "መሕሤያ" for Mahseiah
decisions.reason: Baruch keeps the terms-list form through the book; Mahseiah is new on main and follows the spelling of Maaseiah, "መዕሤያ", with the ḥet.

decisions.choice: "[ልጅ]" supplied after "አጎቴ" at Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "Hanamel my uncle" as "the son of my uncle", as in verses 8 and 9.

decisions.choice: बारूक; नेरिय्याह; महसेयाह
decisions.reason: Baruch is बारूक, the form Nehemiah 3 and 10 use for the name; Neriah is नेरिय्याह and Mahseiah महसेयाह, transcribed from the Hebrew. Balanced gives the grandfather as पोता, as 2 Kings 22:3 does for Shaphan's line. These forms hold through Jeremiah 32-45.

decisions.choice: Варух, сын Нирии, сына Махсеи
decisions.reason: Baruch keeps the form Варух of Nehemiah in this translation. Neriah is Нирия, the traditional form. Mahseiah is a different name from Maaseiah (Маасея in Kings, Chronicles and Ezra), so it is Махсея, not the Synodal Маасея; one form each through Jeremiah 32-51.

decisions.choice: [сына] моего дяди (L); двоюродный брат (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "Hanamel my uncle"; it is read as "the son of my uncle", as in verses 8 and 9 (meaning m2). Literal brackets the supplied word.

decisions.choice: Barukh ben Neriyyah ben Machseyah "マフセヤの子ネリヤの子バルク" (L, B), "ネリヤの息子でマフセヤの孫であるバルク" (R), the 1CH chain pattern; Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe (m1); Chanam'el dodi read as "おじの[子]" (L), "いとこ" (B, R) (m2, footnoted); hayyehudim "ユダの人々" (m4), not "ユダヤ人".
decisions.reason: Names: バルク (NEH), ネリヤ, マフセヤ (new); le'einei "目の前" (L, three times as the Hebrew), B, R "見ていた" (m3).

ru.R: Пока все они смотрели, я сказал Варуху:
