decisions.choice: before their eyes: in front of the witnesses
decisions.reason: Jeremiah gives his orders in public, as he gave the deed (verse 12), so that all who saw the sale also heard what was to be done with the documents and why.

decisions.choice: I charged: gave a formal order
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for commanding. Jeremiah, speaking for the LORD, gives Baruch a duty to carry out (verse 14).

decisions.choice: va'atsavveh "命じて言った" (L), "こう命じた" (B), "言いました" (R), a formal charge (m2); le'eineihem "彼らの目の前で" (L), "彼らの前で" (B), "みなが見ている前で" (R) (m1).
decisions.reason: As the English levels.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת סֵפֶר֩ הַמִּקְנָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָת֗וּם וְאֵ֨ת סֵ֤פֶר הַגָּלוּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בִּכְלִי־חָ֑רֶשׂ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: Taking the deeds these, [the] deed of the purchase this, and the sealed [one] and [the] deed the open this, and you will put them in a vessel of earthenware, so that they may last days many.

en.L: "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase, both the sealed [one] and this open deed, and put them in an earthenware vessel, so that they may last many days.
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Take these documents, this deed of purchase, both the sealed copy and the open one, and put them in a clay jar so that they will last for a long time.
en.R: "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Take these two copies of the deed of purchase, the sealed one and the open one. Put them in a clay jar, so that they will be kept safe for many years.

es.L: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Toma estas escrituras, esta escritura de la compra, tanto la sellada como esta escritura abierta, y ponlas en una vasija de barro, para que duren muchos días.
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Toma estos documentos, esta escritura de compra, tanto la copia sellada como la abierta, y ponlos en una vasija de barro para que se conserven por mucho tiempo.
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Toma estas dos copias de la escritura de compra, la sellada y la abierta. Ponlas en una vasija de barro, para que se guarden bien durante muchos años.

fr.L: « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Prends ces actes, cet acte d’achat, celui qui est scellé et cet acte ouvert, et mets-les dans un vase de terre, afin qu’ils durent de nombreux jours.
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Prends ces documents, cet acte d’achat, l’exemplaire scellé et l’exemplaire ouvert, et mets-les dans une jarre en terre cuite, pour qu’ils se conservent longtemps.
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Prends ces deux exemplaires de l’acte d’achat, celui qui est scellé et celui qui est ouvert. Mets-les dans une jarre en terre cuite, pour qu’ils restent en sécurité pendant de nombreuses années.

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Zichukue hati hizi, hati hii ya ununuzi, ile iliyotiwa muhuri na hati hii iliyo wazi, uzitie katika chombo cha udongo, ili zidumu siku nyingi.
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Chukua hati hizi, hati hii ya ununuzi, nakala iliyotiwa muhuri na ile iliyo wazi, uzitie katika gudulia la udongo ili zidumu kwa muda mrefu.
sw.R: "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Chukua nakala hizi mbili za hati ya ununuzi, iliyotiwa muhuri na iliyo wazi. Zitie katika mtungi wa udongo, ili zihifadhiwe salama kwa miaka mingi.

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Hãy lấy các khế ước này, khế ước mua bán này, cả bản đã đóng ấn và bản để mở này, rồi đặt chúng vào một cái bình bằng đất, để chúng được giữ lâu ngày.
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Hãy lấy các văn kiện này, khế ước mua bán này, cả bản đã đóng ấn lẫn bản để mở, rồi bỏ vào một cái bình đất để chúng được giữ lâu dài.
vi.R: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Hãy lấy hai bản khế ước mua bán này, bản đã đóng ấn và bản để mở. Hãy bỏ chúng vào một cái bình đất để chúng được giữ an toàn trong nhiều năm.

ko.L: "이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이 증서들, 곧 봉인한 이 매매 증서와 봉인하지 않은 이 증서를 가져다가, 오랫동안 보존되도록 질그릇에 넣어 두어라.
ko.B: "이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 이 문서들, 곧 봉인한 매매 증서와 봉인하지 않은 증서를 가져다가 오지그릇에 넣어 두어서, 오랫동안 보존되게 하여라.
ko.R: "이스라엘의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 이 매매 증서 두 장, 곧 봉인한 것과 봉인하지 않은 것을 가져가거라. 그것을 흙으로 빚은 항아리에 넣어 두어서 여러 해 동안 안전하게 보관되게 하여라.

pt.L: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Toma estas escrituras, esta escritura da compra, tanto a selada como esta escritura aberta, e põe-nas num vaso de barro, para que durem muitos dias.
pt.B: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Toma estes documentos, esta escritura de compra, tanto a cópia selada como a aberta, e coloca-os num jarro de barro, para que se conservem por muito tempo.
pt.R: "É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Pega as duas cópias da escritura de compra, a selada e a aberta. Coloca-as num jarro de barro, para que fiquem guardadas em segurança por muitos anos.

am.L: «የእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነዚህን ውሎች፣ ይህን የታተመውን የግዢ ውልና ይህን የተከፈተውን ውል ውሰድ፤ ብዙ ቀንም እንዲቆዩ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።
am.B: «የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነዚህን ሰነዶች፣ ይህን የግዢ ውል፣ የታተመውንም የተከፈተውንም ቅጂ ወስደህ ለረጅም ጊዜ እንዲቆዩ በሸክላ ማሰሮ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።
am.R: «የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነዚህን ሁለት የግዢ ውል ቅጂዎች፣ የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን ውሰድ። ለብዙ ዓመታት በደኅና እንዲቀመጡ በሸክላ ማሰሮ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።

hi.L: "सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यों कहते हैं: ये दस्तावेज़ ले लो, ख़रीद का यह दस्तावेज़, मुहरबंद [प्रति] भी और यह खुला दस्तावेज़ भी, और इन्हें मिट्टी के एक बरतन में रख दो, ताकि ये बहुत दिनों तक बने रहें।
hi.B: "सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: ये काग़ज़ात ले लो, ख़रीद का यह दस्तावेज़, मुहरबंद प्रति भी और खुली प्रति भी, और इन्हें मिट्टी के घड़े में रख दो, ताकि ये लंबे समय तक सुरक्षित रहें।
hi.R: "सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: ख़रीद के दस्तावेज़ की ये दोनों प्रतियाँ ले लो, मुहरबंद प्रति भी और खुली प्रति भी। इन्हें मिट्टी के एक घड़े में रख दो, ताकि ये बहुत वर्षों तक सुरक्षित रहें।

ru.L: «Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Возьми эти записи, эту купчую, и запечатанную, и эту открытую запись, и положи их в глиняный сосуд, чтобы они сохранились многие дни.
ru.B: «Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Возьми эти документы, эту купчую — и запечатанный экземпляр, и открытый — и положи их в глиняный кувшин, чтобы они сохранились надолго.
ru.R: «Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: Возьми оба экземпляра купчей, запечатанный и открытый. Положи их в глиняный кувшин, чтобы они сохранились на много лет.

ja.L: 「万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。これらの証書、すなわち、この購入の証書の封印されたものと、この開いたままの証書とを取り、それらを土の器に入れよ。それらが長い日々の間、保たれるためである。
ja.B: 「万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。これらの証書、すなわち、この購入の証書の封印された写しと、開いたままの写しを取り、素焼きのつぼに納めなさい。長い年月の間、保存されるためである。
ja.R: 「天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。購入の証書の二通の写しを、封印されたものも、開いたままのものも取って、素焼きのつぼに入れなさい。そうすれば、何年もの間、安全に保管される。

uk.L: «Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїлю: Візьми ці грамоти, цю купчу грамоту, і запечатану, і цю відкриту грамоту, і поклади їх у глиняну посудину, щоб вони збереглися багато днів.
uk.B: «Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїлю: Візьми ці документи, цю купчу, і запечатаний примірник, і відкритий, і поклади їх у глиняний глечик, щоб вони збереглися надовго.
uk.R: «Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю: Візьми обидва примірники купчої, запечатаний і відкритий. Поклади їх у глиняний глечик, щоб вони зберігалися в безпеці багато років.

decisions.choice: an earthenware vessel: a clay jar for keeping documents
decisions.reason: Clay jars were used to store scrolls and documents, since they kept out damp and pests; the scrolls found near the Dead Sea had been kept in jars for some two thousand years. Sealed in a jar, the deeds would survive the fall of the city and the long exile.

decisions.choice: take: the verb form gives a firm command
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the plain infinitive of the verb, which can serve as a strong order.

decisions.choice: so that they may last many days: be preserved for a long time
decisions.reason: The deeds are to be kept until the time when land is bought and sold again (verse 15). Jeremiah later says the exile will last seventy years (25:11; 29:10).

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (L); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this title in Isaiah and Jeremiah; the main note is at Isaiah 1:9. Jeremiah's words to Baruch open a quotation that closes at the end of verse 15.

decisions.choice: deeds (L); documents (B); two copies (R)
decisions.reason: The plural names the two copies of verse 11. Balanced says "documents" and Readable "two copies" so that the list reads plainly.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah says "hãy" to Baruch with no pronoun
decisions.reason: The words are God's command passed on to Baruch, so Vietnamese gives them as a plain command; Jeremiah's relation to his scribe needs no pronoun here.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks to Baruch in 해라체, giving God's command
decisions.reason: Baruch is Jeremiah's scribe and helper (meaning decision m1 of 32:12), and the command is God's, so it is in the plain style; the formula takes the honorific because Jeremiah speaks it.

decisions.choice: tu (God's command to Baruch)
decisions.reason: The command is God's own word to Baruch, spoken through Jeremiah, so it takes the "tu" with which God speaks to one person ("Toma", "põe").

decisions.choice: YHWH tsevaot: Literal "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት", Balanced and Readable "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}"
decisions.reason: The form of the terms lists, used through these chapters; "the God of Israel" comes first in Amharic as a title before the name.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} (every level)
decisions.reason: "The LORD of hosts" (of Armies at B and R in English) is सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} at every level, the form the terms notes set after Romans 9:29. Jeremiah speaks to Baruch with तुम.

decisions.choice: ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф (L, B); ГОСПОДЬ Воинств (R)
decisions.reason: YHWH of hosts in the forms the history and Prophets notes set: Саваоф (as Romans 9:29) at Literal and Balanced, Воинств at Readable, where the English Readable has "of Armies".

decisions.choice: lakoach "取り" (a firm command, m2), with the oracle forms "入れよ" (L), "納めなさい" (B), "入れなさい" (R), since God's message is given through Jeremiah; kli cheres "土の器" (L), "素焼きのつぼ" (B, R) (m1); ya'amdu yamim rabbim "長い日々の間、保たれる" (L), "長い年月の間、保存される" (B), "何年もの間、安全に保管される" (R) (m3).
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's words to Baruch open with 「 and close at verse 15, as the English.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֛ים וְשָׂד֥וֹת וּכְרָמִ֖ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: Again will be bought houses and fields and vineyards in the land this.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land."
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: People will once more buy houses, fields and vineyards in this land."
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Some day people will again buy houses, fields and vineyards in this land."

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Todavía se comprarán casas, y campos, y viñas en esta tierra».
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Otra vez se comprarán casas, campos y viñas en esta tierra».
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Algún día la gente volverá a comprar casas, campos y viñas en esta tierra».

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : On achètera encore des maisons, des champs et des vignes dans ce pays. »
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : On achètera de nouveau des maisons, des champs et des vignes dans ce pays. »
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Un jour, les gens achèteront de nouveau des maisons, des champs et des vignes dans ce pays. »

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Nyumba na mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu yatanunuliwa tena katika nchi hii."
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Watu watanunua tena nyumba, mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu katika nchi hii."
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Siku moja watu watanunua tena nyumba, mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu katika nchi hii."

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Nhà cửa, đồng ruộng và vườn nho sẽ lại được mua bán trong xứ này."
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Người ta sẽ lại mua nhà cửa, đồng ruộng và vườn nho trong xứ này."
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Một ngày kia người ta sẽ lại mua nhà cửa, đồng ruộng và vườn nho trong xứ này."

ko.L: 이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이 땅에서 집과 밭과 포도원을 다시 사게 될 것이다."
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 사람들이 이 땅에서 다시 집과 밭과 포도원을 사고팔 것이다."
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 언젠가 사람들이 이 땅에서 다시 집과 밭과 포도원을 살 것이다."

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ainda se comprarão casas, e campos, e vinhas nesta terra."
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: As pessoas voltarão a comprar casas, campos e vinhas nesta terra."
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Algum dia as pessoas vão comprar de novo casas, campos e vinhas nesta terra."

am.L: የእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላልና፦ በዚህች ምድር ቤቶችና እርሻዎች የወይን ቦታዎችም እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።»
am.B: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ በዚህች ምድር ሰዎች ቤቶችን፣ እርሻዎችንና የወይን ቦታዎችን እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።»
am.R: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ አንድ ቀን ሰዎች በዚህች ምድር ቤቶችን፣ እርሻዎችንና የወይን ቦታዎችን እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።»

hi.L: क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यों कहते हैं: इस देश में फिर से घर और खेत और दाख की बारियाँ मोल ली जाएँगी।"
hi.B: क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: लोग इस देश में फिर से घर, खेत और दाख की बारियाँ मोल लेंगे।"
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: एक दिन लोग इस देश में फिर से घर, खेत और अंगूर के बाग़ ख़रीदेंगे।"

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Ещё будут покупать дома, и поля, и виноградники в этой земле.»
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: В этой земле снова будут покупать дома, поля и виноградники.»
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: Когда-нибудь люди снова будут покупать в этой земле дома, поля и виноградники.»

ja.L: まことに、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。この地で、再び家と畑とぶどう畑が買われるようになる。」
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。この地で、人々は再び家や畑やぶどう畑を買うようになる。」
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。いつか、この地で、人々はまた、家や畑やぶどう畑を買うようになる。」

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїлю: Ще купуватимуть доми, і поля, і виноградники в цій землі».
uk.B: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїлю: Люди знову купуватимуть доми, поля й виноградники в цій землі».
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю: Колись люди знову купуватимуть доми, поля й виноградники в цій землі».

decisions.choice: houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought: the purchase is a sign of hope
decisions.reason: The field was bought while the land was held by the enemy and the city was about to fall. By keeping the deeds, Jeremiah shows that the LORD's judgment is not the end: his people will return and ordinary life, with its buying and selling of land, will go on again in Judah (verses 43-44).

decisions.choice: for: the reason for keeping the deeds
decisions.reason: The word gives the reason behind the order of verse 14: the deeds must last, because the land will one day be bought and sold again.

decisions.choice: will again be bought (L); People will once more buy (B); Some day people will again buy (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive; Balanced and Readable name the buyers in general, and Readable adds "some day" for the future the verb looks to.

decisions.choice: будут покупать
decisions.reason: Russian expresses the Hebrew passive "will be bought" naturally with an impersonal third person plural; the buyers are people in general, as at the other levels.

decisions.choice: 'od yiqqanu "再び……買われるようになる" (L, the passive), "人々は再び……買うようになる" (B), "いつか……また" (R): the purchase as a sign of hope (m1).
decisions.reason: As the English levels.

ko.R: 그 증서를 네리야의 아들 바룩에게 준 뒤에 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다. 내가 말했다.

hi.L: और नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक को ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ देने के बाद मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की, कि:
hi.B: नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक को ख़रीद का दस्तावेज़ दे चुकने के बाद मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की:
hi.R: नेरिय्याह के बेटे बारूक को दस्तावेज़ देने के बाद मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की। मैंने कहा:

decisions.choice: I prayed: Jeremiah's prayer runs from verse 17 to verse 25
decisions.reason: The prayer praises the LORD as Creator and as the God of the exodus (verses 17-22), confesses Israel's disobedience (verse 23), and ends with Jeremiah's puzzlement at being told to buy land in a city about to fall (verses 24-25). The LORD answers in verses 26-44.

decisions.choice: Once I had given ... I prayed (B); After I gave ... I prayed (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the time first, as English tells events in order.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's prayer (verses 17-25, m1) is a prose prayer: です・ます at every level, God addressed as あなた with light respect forms for his acts, as the JER conventions for Jeremiah to God in prose (1:6, 14:13).
decisions.reason: JER-1, JER-3 register; OT supplement (prose prayers です・ます).

source.text: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא־יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Ah, my Lord Yahweh! Look, you made the heavens and the earth by your power the great and by your arm the outstretched; not is too hard for you any thing;

en.L: "Ah, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! Look, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} made the heavens and the earth by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great strength and by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} outstretched arm; no thing is too hard for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: "Oh, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! You are the one who made the heavens and the earth with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great strength, with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm stretched out. There is nothing too hard for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: "Oh, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! You made the heavens and the earth with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great power and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty arm. Nothing is too hard for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: «¡Ay, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! He aquí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste los cielos y la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder y con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo extendido; no hay nada que sea demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: «¡Ay, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! Tú eres quien hizo los cielos y la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder, con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo extendido. No hay nada demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: «¡Oh, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! Tú hiciste los cielos y la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo fuerte. Nada es demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: « Ah, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Voici, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait les cieux et la terre par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande force et par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras étendu ; rien n’est trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: « Ah, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait les cieux et la terre par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande force, par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras étendu. Rien n’est trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: « Ah, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Tu as fait le ciel et la terre par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande puissance et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras puissant. Rien n’est trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: "Aa, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} umezifanya mbingu na nchi kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu na kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulionyoshwa; hakuna neno lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Wewe ndiye uliyezifanya mbingu na nchi kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu, kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulionyoshwa. Hakuna jambo lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Wewe uliziumba mbingu na nchi kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wenye nguvu. Hakuna jambo lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

vi.L: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Kìa, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên trời và đất bằng quyền năng lớn lao và cánh tay giơ ra của Ngài; không có việc gì quá khó cho Ngài.
vi.B: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng đã làm nên trời và đất bằng quyền năng lớn lao và cánh tay giơ ra của Ngài. Không có việc gì quá khó cho Ngài.
vi.R: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đã làm nên trời và đất bằng quyền năng lớn lao và cánh tay mạnh mẽ của Ngài. Không có việc gì quá khó cho Ngài.

ko.L: "아, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 보십시오, 주님께서 친히 큰 능력과 펴신 팔로 하늘과 땅을 만드셨습니다. 주님께는 너무 어려운 일이 하나도 없습니다.
ko.B: "아, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 주님께서는 크신 능력과 뻗으신 팔로 하늘과 땅을 만드신 분이십니다. 주님께는 너무 어려운 일이 없습니다.
ko.R: "아, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 주님께서는 크신 능력과 강한 팔로 하늘과 땅을 만드셨습니다. 주님께서 하지 못하실 일은 아무것도 없습니다.

pt.L: "Ah, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Eis que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mesmo fizeste os céus e a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} grande poder e com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} braço estendido; nenhuma coisa é difícil demais para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: "Ah, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Foste tu que fizeste os céus e a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} grande poder, com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} braço estendido. Não há nada difícil demais para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: "Ah, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Tu fizeste os céus e a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} grande poder e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} braço forte. Nada é difícil demais para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

hi.L: "हाय, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}! देख, तू ही ने अपने बड़े सामर्थ्य से और अपनी बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से आकाश और पृथ्वी को बनाया; तेरे लिए कोई बात बहुत कठिन नहीं है।
hi.B: "हाय, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}! तू ही है जिसने अपने बड़े सामर्थ्य से, अपनी बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से, आकाश और पृथ्वी को बनाया। तेरे लिए कुछ भी कठिन नहीं है।
hi.R: "हाय, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}! तूने अपनी बड़ी शक्ति और अपनी बलवंत भुजा से आकाश और पृथ्वी को बनाया। तेरे लिए कुछ भी कठिन नहीं है।

ru.L: «Ах, Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Вот, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сотворил небеса и землю великой силой {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} и простёртой мышцей {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}}; ничто не слишком трудно для {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.B: «О Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Это {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сотворил небеса и землю своей великой силой и простёртой рукой. Нет ничего слишком трудного для {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.R: «О Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Ты сотворил небо и землю своей великой силой и могучей рукой. Нет ничего слишком трудного для {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: 「ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。ご覧ください、あなたこそ、大いなる力と伸ばした腕によって、天と地を造られました。あなたにとって、難しすぎることは何一つありません。
ja.B: 「ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。あなたこそ、大いなる力と伸ばした腕で、天と地を造られた方です。あなたにできないことは何一つありません。
ja.R: 「ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。あなたは、大きな力と強い腕で、天と地をお造りになりました。あなたにとって、難しすぎることは何もありません。

uk.L: «Ах, Владико {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}! Ось {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} сам створив небеса і землю {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} великою силою і {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} простягнутим раменом; ніщо не надто важке для {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.B: «О, Владико {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}! Ти той, хто створив небеса й землю {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} великою силою, {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} простягнутим раменом. Немає нічого надто важкого для {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: «О, Владико {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}! Ти створив небо й землю {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} великою силою і {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} могутньою рукою. Для {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} немає нічого надто важкого.

decisions.choice: nothing is too hard for you: the question of Genesis 18:14 turned into a confession
decisions.reason: The verb means to be too wonderful or too difficult, beyond what anyone can do. When Sarah laughed at the promise of a son, the LORD asked, "Is anything too hard for the LORD?" (Genesis 18:14). Jeremiah answers that question with faith, and the LORD takes up his words in verse 27.

decisions.choice: your great strength and your outstretched arm: God's power in action
decisions.reason: The outstretched arm is a picture of strength at work, used most often of the exodus (verse 21; Deuteronomy 26:8). Here it is used of creation, as in 27:5: the God who made everything is able to do what he has promised.

decisions.choice: ah: a cry addressed to God
decisions.reason: The same cry opens Jeremiah's protest in 1:6 and 4:10 and 14:13. Here it is the start of a prayer of praise that ends in perplexity (verses 24-25).

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the title Adonai ("Lord") followed by the divine name, as in 1:6. Writing the name as GOD after "Lord" avoids "Lord LORD", as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: too hard (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same words are used as in Genesis 18:14 at Literal and Readable, so that readers can hear the echo; verse 27 matches. Readable says "mighty arm" for the outstretched arm. Jeremiah's prayer opens a quotation that closes at the end of verse 25.

decisions.choice: Señor DIOS
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH keeps the published form "el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}", here in direct address after "¡Ay!" (Literal, Balanced) and "¡Oh!" (Readable).

decisions.choice: demasiado difícil
decisions.reason: The same words at every level here and in verse 27, so the LORD's answer is heard taking up Jeremiah's confession (Genesis 18:14).

decisions.choice: Bwana MUNGU
decisions.reason: "The Lord GOD" is "Bwana" with "MUNGU" under the divine-name setting, as the earlier books; Literal opens with the cry "Aa", Balanced and Readable with the vocative "Ee".

decisions.choice: "Seigneur DIEU"
decisions.reason: Adonai followed by the divine name, as the terms note sets it: "le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}". "Rien n'est trop difficile" is kept at every level and again in verse 27, as the echo of Genesis 18:14.

decisions.choice: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là CHÚA" for "Ah, Lord GOD"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for this cry (1:6; 4:10; 32:17): Adonai is "Chúa" and the divine name keeps its setting. Jeremiah prays as "con" and calls God "Ngài", as in 18:19.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" for "Lord GOD"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for *Adonai YHWH*, as Psalm 69:7.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's prayer (verses 17-25) in 합쇼체 with "주님" and "저"
decisions.reason: As the terms note lists 32:17-25 among the prayers: 합쇼체, and no second-person pronoun for God.

decisions.choice: Ah, Senhor DEUS! (every level); difícil demais
decisions.reason: The cry and the title keep the words 1:6 sets for the book; here the cry opens praise (m3), so Readable keeps plain "Ah" without the "não" of 1:6. "Difícil demais" is the phrase of Genesis 18:14 in Portuguese (m1), kept at every level and in verse 27 so the echo can be heard. Jeremiah prays to God with "tu".

decisions.choice: "አቤቱ" for the cry ʾahah addressed to God; Readable leaves it in "ሆይ"
decisions.reason: "ወዮ" is the terms list's word for hoy (woe); ʾahah here is a cry of a man praying, and "አቤቱ" is the Amharic cry that turns to God in distress.

decisions.choice: Adonai YHWH as "ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms list form; only the name is inside the span.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उनका), while Jeremiah's prayer uses तू, the address of Hindi prayer.

decisions.choice: हाय, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}!
decisions.reason: "Lord GOD" (Adonai YHWH) is प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, as in 1:6, so as not to say प्रभु twice; the cry "ah" is हाय, as there.

decisions.choice: कठिन (verses 17 and 27)
decisions.reason: "Too hard" is said with कठिन at every level here and in verse 27, the word Genesis 18:14 uses at Literal, so that the echo of Sarah's story and of God's answer can be heard.

decisions.choice: Ах, Владыка ГОСПОДИ (L); О Владыка ГОСПОДИ (B, R)
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH is Владыка ГОСПОДЬ, as the Prophets note and Jeremiah 1:6 have it, here in the vocative. Jeremiah addresses God as ты; the pronouns for God take deity_pronoun spans except a sentence-initial "Ты".

decisions.choice: слишком трудно / трудного
decisions.reason: The words of Genesis 18:14 in this translation ("слишком трудное"), so that the echo is heard (meaning m1); verse 27 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: 'ahah 'adonai YHWH "ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ" (every level, JER-1; m3); hinneh to God "ご覧ください" (L, as 1:6 and 14:13), left out at B, R as the English; lo' yippale' mimmekha kol davar "難しすぎることは何一つありません" (L, R), "できないことは何一つありません" (B), echoing GEN 18:14 (m1) and answered in verse 27.
decisions.reason: zero'akha hannetuyah "伸ばした腕" (L, B), "強い腕" (R), as JER 27:5 (JER-4) (m2).

source.text: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Doing loyal love to thousands and repaying [the] iniquity of fathers into [the] bosom of their sons after them, the God the great, the mighty, Yahweh of hosts [is] his name,

en.L: [You] show loyal love to thousands and repay the iniquity of fathers into the lap of their {{gender:children|sons}} after them, the great [and] mighty God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name,
en.B: You show loyal love to thousands, yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pay back the guilt of {{gender:parents|fathers}} into the laps of their {{gender:children|sons}} after them. You are the great and mighty God, whose name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies,
en.R: You show faithful love to thousands of people. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} also repay the sins of {{gender:parents|fathers}} to their {{gender:children|sons}} who come after them. You are the great and powerful God. Your name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: [Tú] haces amor leal a millares y pagas la iniquidad de los padres en el regazo de sus hijos después de ellos; el Dios grande, poderoso, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre,
es.B: Tú muestras amor fiel a millares, pero también haces pagar la culpa de los padres a sus hijos después de ellos. Tú eres el Dios grande y poderoso, cuyo nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos,
es.R: Tú muestras amor fiel a miles de personas. Pero también haces pagar a los hijos por los pecados de los padres que vivieron antes que ellos. Tú eres el Dios grande y poderoso. Tu nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: [Tu] fais preuve d’amour loyal envers des milliers, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rends l’iniquité des pères dans le sein de leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} après eux, le Dieu grand [et] puissant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom,
fr.B: Tu fais preuve d’amour fidèle envers des milliers, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais retomber la faute des {{gender:parents|pères}} sur leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} après eux. Tu es le Dieu grand et puissant, dont le nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées,
fr.R: Tu montres {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle à des milliers de gens. Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais aussi payer les péchés des {{gender:parents|pères}} à leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} qui viennent après eux. Tu es le Dieu grand et puissant. Ton nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: [Wewe] unawaonyesha maelfu upendo usiokoma, na kulipa uovu wa baba vifuani mwa watoto wao baada yao, Mungu mkuu, [mwenye] nguvu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}},
sw.B: Unawaonyesha maelfu upendo usiokoma, lakini unalipa hatia ya wazazi vifuani mwa watoto wao baada yao. Wewe ndiwe Mungu mkuu na mwenye nguvu, ambaye jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi,
sw.R: Unawaonyesha maelfu ya watu upendo usiokoma. Lakini pia unawalipa watoto wanaokuja baada ya wazazi wao kwa dhambi za wazazi hao. Wewe ndiwe Mungu mkuu na mwenye nguvu. Jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: [Ngài] tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín cho hàng ngàn người, và báo trả tội ác của cha ông vào lòng con cháu sau họ; Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại [và] quyền năng, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân,
vi.B: Ngài tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín cho hàng ngàn người, nhưng cũng báo trả tội lỗi của cha mẹ trên con cháu sau họ. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại và quyền năng, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân,
vi.R: Ngài tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi cho hàng ngàn người. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng báo trả tội lỗi của cha mẹ cho con cháu sau họ. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại và đầy quyền năng. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.

ko.L: [주님께서는] 수천 대에 이르기까지 한결같은 사랑을 베푸시고, 아버지들의 죄악을 그들 뒤에 오는 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}의 품에 갚으십니다. 크고 능하신 하나님, 그 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 수천 대에 이르기까지 한결같은 사랑을 베푸시지만, {{gender:부모|아버지들}}의 허물을 그 뒤를 잇는 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}에게 갚으십니다. 주님은 크고 능하신 하나님이시며, 그 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 수많은 사람에게 변함없는 사랑을 베푸십니다. 그러나 {{gender:부모|아버지들}}의 죄를 그 뒤에 오는 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}에게도 갚으십니다. 주님은 크고 강하신 하나님이십니다. 주님의 이름은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다.

pt.L: [Tu] mostras amor leal a milhares e retribuis a iniquidade dos pais no colo dos seus filhos depois deles, o Deus grande [e] poderoso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [é] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome,
pt.B: Tu mostras amor leal a milhares, mas fazes recair a culpa dos pais no colo dos seus filhos depois deles. Tu és o Deus grande e poderoso, cujo nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos,
pt.R: Tu mostras amor fiel a milhares de pessoas. Mas também castigas os pecados dos pais nos filhos que vêm depois deles. Tu és o Deus grande e poderoso. O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ለሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅርን ታደርጋለህ፤ የአባቶችንም በደል ከእነርሱ በኋላ በልጆቻቸው ብብት ትመልሳለህ፤ ታላቅና ኃያል አምላክ ሆይ፣ ስሙ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት [ነው]፤
am.B: ለሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅርን ታሳያለህ፤ ሆኖም {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} በደል ከእነርሱ በኋላ በሚመጡት ልጆቻቸው ላይ ትመልሳለህ። ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሆነ ታላቅና ኃያል አምላክ አንተ ነህ፤
am.R: ለሺዎች ሰዎች ጽኑ ፍቅርን ታሳያለህ። ነገር ግን {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} ኃጢአት ከእነርሱ በኋላ በሚመጡት ልጆቻቸው ላይ ትመልሳለህ። አንተ ታላቅና ብርቱ አምላክ ነህ። ስምህ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።

hi.L: [तू] हज़ारों पर अटल प्रेम करता है, और पिताओं के अधर्म का बदला उनके बाद उनके {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} की गोद में देता है; महान [और] पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम [है],
hi.B: तू हज़ारों पर अटल प्रेम करता है, फिर भी तू {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} के दोष का बदला उनके बाद उनके {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} की गोद में देता है। तू महान और पराक्रमी परमेश्वर है, जिसका नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है,
hi.R: तू हज़ारों लोगों पर अटल प्रेम दिखाता है। पर तू {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} के पापों का बदला उनके बाद आनेवाले उनके {{gender:बच्चों|बेटों}} को भी देता है। तू महान और सामर्थी परमेश्वर है। तेरा नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है।

ru.L: [Ты] являешь неизменную любовь тысячам и воздаёшь за беззаконие отцов в лоно их {{gender:детей|сыновей}} после них, Бог великий, могучий, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф — имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}},
ru.B: Ты являешь неизменную любовь тысячам, но воздаёшь за вину {{gender:родителей|отцов}} их {{gender:детям|сыновьям}} после них. Ты — великий и могучий Бог, и {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф,
ru.R: Ты проявляешь неизменную любовь к тысячам людей. Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} и наказываешь {{gender:детей|сыновей}} за грехи их {{gender:родителей|отцов}}, которые жили до них. Ты великий и сильный Бог. Твоё имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: あなたは、幾千の者に誠実を尽くし、父たちの咎を、彼らの後の子らのふところに報いられます。大いなる力ある神、その名は万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.B: あなたは、幾千の者に変わらぬいつくしみを示し、{{gender:親たち|父たち}}の咎を、その後の子らのふところに報いられます。あなたは大いなる力ある神、その名は万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}です。
ja.R: あなたは、何千もの人々に変わらない愛を示されます。けれども、{{gender:親たち|父たち}}の罪を、その後に生まれる子どもたちに報いられます。あなたは偉大で、力のある神です。あなたの名は、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}です。

uk.L: [Ти] виявляєш незмінну любов тисячам і віддаєш беззаконня батьків у лоно їхніх {{gender:дітей|синів}} після них, великий [і] могутній Боже, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот — {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя,
uk.B: Ти виявляєш незмінну любов тисячам, але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} й віддаєш провину батьків у лоно їхніх {{gender:дітей|синів}} після них. Ти — великий і могутній Бог, чиє імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ,
uk.R: Ти виявляєш вірну любов тисячам людей. Але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} й відплачуєш за гріхи батьків їхнім {{gender:дітям|синам}}, які приходять після них. Ти — великий і могутній Бог. Твоє імʼя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: loyal love to thousands and repaying the iniquity of fathers on their children: the words of Exodus 20:5-6 and 34:6-7
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's praise takes up the LORD's own description of himself given at Sinai: he keeps loyal love to thousands, and he brings the iniquity of the fathers on the children (Exodus 20:5-6; 34:7; Deuteronomy 5:9-10). Both halves are now being seen: the iniquity of generations is coming home to Jerusalem (verses 30-35), and the loyal love will bring the people back (verses 37-41).

decisions.choice: loyal love (hesed): love that keeps faith within a covenant bond
decisions.reason: The word means love that is loyal and faithful, keeping a bond and going beyond what duty requires (Exodus 34:6). "Thousands" may mean thousands of people or of generations (Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: into the lap of their children: repaying in full, so that it falls on them
decisions.reason: The lap is the fold of the garment, used to carry things; to pay something "into the lap" is to give it fully and personally (Isaiah 65:6-7; Psalm 79:12). The effects of the fathers' sin fall on those who come after. Jeremiah also says that each one will die for his own sin (31:29-30).

decisions.choice: the great, the mighty God, the LORD of hosts is his name: praise that turns from "you" to "he"
decisions.reason: The prayer speaks to God as "you", then names him in the third person, as hymns often do (10:16; Deuteronomy 10:17). The titles run on into verse 19.

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R); iniquity (L), guilt (B), sins (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for these words in Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: You are ... whose name is (B); Your name is (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "You are" and Readable says "your name", keeping the prayer in one voice; Literal keeps the Hebrew shift to "his name". Readable ends the sentence here; Literal and Balanced carry it on into verse 19.

decisions.choice: los padres ... sus hijos
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" and "hijos" already include mothers and daughters, so no gender span is used where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "cha ông ... con cháu" (L); "cha mẹ ... con cháu" (B, R), with no gender spans
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cháu" and "cha mẹ" already include daughters and mothers, so the English gender alternatives have no second Vietnamese wording; hesed takes the settled "tình yêu thương thành tín" / "tình thương không hề thay đổi".

decisions.choice: "{{gender:자녀들|아들들}}"; "{{gender:부모|아버지들}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English, the sons and fathers of the Exodus 20:5-6 formula (meaning decision m1) mean children and parents; the alternatives give the literal "sons" and "fathers". Literal keeps "아버지들", as the English Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B); "변함없는 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalms note's forms for *ḥesed* (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: os pais; os filhos (no gender setting)
decisions.reason: The English sets "parents/fathers" and "children/sons" under the gender setting. Portuguese "os pais" and "os filhos" already mean both sexes, as the Old Testament terms say of "filhos", so no setting is needed. The words follow Exodus 20:5-6 in Portuguese ("amor leal a milhares", "a iniquidade dos pais", "a culpa dos pais"), which the verse takes up (m1).

decisions.choice: ḥesed as "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms list word; the words echo Exodus 20:5-6 and 34:6-7.

decisions.choice: "በልጆቻቸው ብብት" (into the bosom of their children) kept at Literal
decisions.reason: The picture of repaying into the lap; Balanced and Readable say "on their children".

decisions.choice: अटल प्रेम (every level); अधर्म (L), दोष (B), पाप (R)
decisions.reason: God's hesed is अटल प्रेम, as Exodus 34:7 and the Psalms have it; iniquity follows the Pentateuch note's levels. Literal keeps the Hebrew turn to "his name" with the honorific उनका.

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь; беззаконие (L), вина (B), грехи (R)
decisions.reason: Hesed is "неизменная любовь" at every level, as in the Psalms and Jeremiah 16:5; iniquity is "беззаконие" at Literal and "вина" at Balanced, as in Jeremiah 16:10. The words echo Exodus 20:5-6 and 34:6-7 (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: имя его (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew turn from "you" to "his name" (meaning m4); Balanced and Readable keep the prayer in one voice, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'oseh chesed la'alafim umeshallem 'avon 'avot 'el cheiq beneihem "幾千の者に誠実を尽くし……ふところに報いられます" (L), as EXO 20:5-6, 34:6-7 (m1); hesed "誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B), "変わらない愛" (R), the JER-1 row (m2); L keeps the turn to the third person "その名は" (m4).
decisions.reason: God's hesed as JER-1.

decisions.choice: 'avot "{{gender:親たち|父たち}}" (B, R) where the English B, R have parents / fathers, "父たち" (L) with no span as the English L; benim "子ら / 子どもたち" with no span, already inclusive in Japanese, for the English children / sons.
decisions.reason: Style guide sections 7, 7a.

source.text: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־כָּל־דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: great of the counsel and mighty of the deed, whose eyes [are] opened on all [the] ways of [the] sons of man, to give to each according to his ways and according to [the] fruit of his deeds;

en.L: great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes [are] open on all the ways of the {{gender:children|sons}} of man, to give to each according to {{gender:their|his}} ways and according to the fruit of {{gender:their|his}} deeds,
en.B: great in purpose and mighty in action. Your eyes are open to all the ways of humankind, to give each person what {{gender:their|his}} ways deserve and what the fruit of {{gender:their|his}} deeds has earned.
en.R: Your plans are great, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do mighty things. You see everything that people do. You give each person what they deserve for the way they live and for what they do.

es.L: grande en consejo y poderoso en obra, cuyos ojos [están] abiertos sobre todos los caminos de los hijos de los hombres, para dar a cada uno según sus caminos y según el fruto de sus obras;
es.B: grande en propósitos y poderoso en hechos. Tus ojos están abiertos sobre todos los caminos de la humanidad, para dar a cada uno lo que merecen sus caminos y el fruto de sus obras.
es.R: Tus planes son grandes, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces cosas poderosas. Ves todo lo que hace la gente. Le das a cada persona lo que merece por su manera de vivir y por lo que hace.

fr.L: grand en conseil et puissant en action, dont les yeux [sont] ouverts sur toutes les voies des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de l’homme, pour rendre à chacun selon ses voies et selon le fruit de ses actions,
fr.B: grand dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} desseins et puissant dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes. Tes yeux sont ouverts sur toute la conduite des humains, pour rendre à chacun ce que méritent sa conduite et le fruit de ses actes.
fr.R: Tes projets sont grands, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais des choses puissantes. Tu vois tout ce que font les gens. Tu donnes à chacun ce qu’il mérite pour sa manière de vivre et pour ce qu’il fait.

sw.L: mkuu katika shauri na mwenye nguvu katika kazi, ambaye macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [yako] wazi juu ya njia zote za wanadamu, kumpa kila mmoja sawasawa na njia zake na sawasawa na matunda ya matendo yake,
sw.B: mkuu katika makusudi na mwenye nguvu katika matendo. Macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yako wazi kuziona njia zote za wanadamu, ili kumpa kila mtu kadiri ya njia zake na kadiri ya matunda ya matendo yake.
sw.R: Mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ni mikuu, nawe hufanya mambo makuu. Unaona kila kitu ambacho watu hufanya. Unampa kila mtu anachostahili kwa jinsi anavyoishi na kwa yale anayoyafanya.

vi.L: lớn lao về mưu lược và quyền năng trong việc làm, mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở ra trên mọi đường lối của con cái loài người, để báo trả cho mỗi người tùy theo đường lối mình và tùy theo bông trái của việc làm mình,
vi.B: mưu định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao, việc làm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quyền năng. Mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy rõ mọi đường lối của loài người, để ban cho mỗi người tùy theo đường lối họ đáng nhận và theo bông trái việc làm của họ.
vi.R: Chương trình của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những việc quyền năng. Ngài thấy mọi điều người ta làm. Ngài ban cho mỗi người đúng như cách họ sống và những việc họ làm đáng được nhận.

ko.L: 계획에 크시고 행하시는 일에 능하시며, 주님의 눈은 사람의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}의 모든 길을 살피고 계셔서, 각 사람에게 그의 길과 그의 행실의 열매대로 갚아 주십니다.
ko.B: 주님은 계획이 크시고 하시는 일이 능하십니다. 주님의 눈은 사람들의 모든 길을 살피셔서, 각 사람에게 그 행위와 행실의 열매대로 갚아 주십니다.
ko.R: 주님의 계획은 크고, 주님께서는 놀라운 일을 하십니다. 주님께서는 사람들이 하는 모든 일을 보십니다. 주님께서는 사람마다 그가 살아온 대로, 그가 한 일대로 갚아 주십니다.

pt.L: grande em conselho e poderoso em feitos, cujos olhos [estão] abertos sobre todos os caminhos dos {{gender:seres humanos|filhos dos homens}}, para dar a cada um segundo os seus caminhos e segundo o fruto das suas obras,
pt.B: grande em propósitos e poderoso em ações. Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos estão abertos para todos os caminhos da humanidade, para dar a cada pessoa o que os seus caminhos merecem e o que o fruto das suas obras conquistou.
pt.R: Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} planos são grandes, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes coisas poderosas. Tu vês tudo o que as pessoas fazem. Tu dás a cada pessoa o que ela merece pela maneira como vive e pelo que faz.

am.L: በምክር ታላቅ፣ በሥራም ብርቱ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ መንገዱና እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ ትሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይኖችህ በሰው ልጆች መንገድ ሁሉ ላይ የተገለጡ ናቸው፤
am.B: በዓላማ ታላቅ፣ በሥራም ብርቱ ነህ። ለእያንዳንዱ ሰው መንገዱ የሚገባውን፣ የሥራውም ፍሬ ያስገኘውን ትሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይኖችህ የሰውን ልጆች መንገድ ሁሉ ያያሉ።
am.R: ዕቅድህ ታላቅ ነው፤ ብርቱ ሥራዎችንም ትሠራለህ። ሰዎች የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ታያለህ። ለእያንዳንዱ ሰው እንደ ኑሮውና እንደ ሥራው የሚገባውን ትሰጠዋለህ።

hi.L: युक्ति में महान और काम में पराक्रमी, जिसकी आँखें {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}} के सारे चालचलन पर खुली [हैं], ताकि हर एक को उसके चालचलन के अनुसार और उसके कामों के फल के अनुसार दे;
hi.B: तू युक्ति में महान और काम में पराक्रमी है। तेरी आँखें मनुष्यों के सारे चालचलन पर लगी रहती हैं, ताकि तू हर एक को उसके चालचलन और उसके कामों के फल के अनुसार दे।
hi.R: तेरी योजनाएँ महान हैं, और तू सामर्थ के काम करता है। लोग जो कुछ करते हैं, तू सब देखता है। तू हर एक को उसके चालचलन और उसके कामों के अनुसार फल देता है।

ru.L: великий в совете и могучий в деле, чьи глаза открыты на все пути {{gender:детей|сынов}} человеческих, чтобы воздать каждому по его путям и по плодам его дел,
ru.B: великий в замыслах и могучий в делах. Твои глаза открыты на все пути людей, чтобы воздать каждому по его путям и по плодам его дел.
ru.R: Твои замыслы велики, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершаешь могучие дела. Ты видишь всё, что делают люди. Ты воздаёшь каждому по тому, как он живёт и что он делает.

ja.L: 計画に大いなる方、わざに力ある方、あなたの目は人々のすべての道の上に開かれていて、それぞれにその道にしたがい、その行いの実にしたがって報いられます。
ja.B: あなたは、計画に優れ、わざに力ある方です。あなたの目は、人々のすべての歩みに注がれていて、それぞれの生き方にふさわしく、その行いの実にふさわしく報いられます。
ja.R: あなたの計画は偉大で、あなたは力あるわざを行われます。あなたは、人々がすることを、すべて見ておられます。あなたは、一人一人に、その生き方としたことにふさわしい報いを与えられます。

uk.L: великий у раді й могутній у ділі, чиї очі відкриті на всі дороги {{gender:дітей людських|синів людських}}, щоб дати кожному за його дорогами і за плодом його вчинків,
uk.B: великий у задумах і могутній у ділах. Твої очі відкриті на всі дороги людства, щоб дати кожному, на що заслуговують його дороги і що заробив плід його вчинків.
uk.R: Твої задуми великі, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} твориш могутні діла. Ти бачиш усе, що роблять люди. Ти даєш кожному те, на що він заслуговує за своє життя і за свої вчинки.

decisions.choice: great in counsel and mighty in deed: wise in planning and strong in acting
decisions.reason: Counsel is the plan or purpose a king forms; deed is what he carries out. God both plans and does (Isaiah 28:29).

decisions.choice: to give to each according to his ways and the fruit of his deeds: as in 17:10
decisions.reason: The same words close 17:10, where the LORD says he searches the heart. They are given here as there at each level.

decisions.choice: whose eyes are open on all the ways: who sees everything people do
decisions.reason: God's open eyes mean that he watches over and knows how people live; nothing is hidden from him (16:17).

decisions.choice: the children of man (L); humankind (B); people (R); Your eyes (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons of man" means human beings in general. Balanced and Readable start a new sentence and use "your", as the prayer is spoken to God; a pronoun at the start of a sentence is capitalized either way.

decisions.choice: "des enfants de l'homme", with "fils de l'homme" as the gender alternative; "chacun selon ses voies" with no span
decisions.reason: As the English sets on "sons of man"; "chacun ... ses" is already generic French, so the possessives need no span.

decisions.choice: "사람의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}"
decisions.reason: As the English Literal "the children of man", with "sons" as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "사람들", which needs none.

decisions.choice: {{gender:seres humanos|filhos dos homens}} (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "children/sons of man" under the setting. Portuguese keeps the Hebrew phrase in the traditional alternative, "filhos dos homens", and gives its sense, human beings, as the inclusive default. "Cada um", "cada pessoa" and "seus" already include everyone, so the English "their/his" spans need no counterpart.

decisions.choice: उसके, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "their / his". Hindi उसके means "his" or "her" alike, so the generic wording needs no span. "The sons of man" at Literal takes the span the Psalms use, {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}}.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детей|сынов}} человеческих (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has gender spans on "children of man" and on "his"; the Russian possessive "его" after "каждому" is generic, so only the phrase "сынов человеческих" takes the setting, as in the Psalms forms of this translation.

decisions.choice: benei 'adam "人々" (every level), with no gender span: Japanese "人々", "それぞれ", "一人一人" are inclusive, for the English children / sons and their / his spans; "人の子ら" is avoided so as not to echo the title "人の子" (m3).
decisions.reason: Style guide sections 6, 7a.

decisions.choice: gedol ha'etsah verav ha'aliliyyah "計画に大いなる方、わざに力ある方" (L), "計画に優れ、わざに力ある方" (B), R in sentences (m1); "その行いの実にしたがって" as JER 17:10 (m2).
decisions.reason: As the English levels.

source.text: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָֽאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: who set signs and wonders in [the] land of Egypt until the day this, and in Israel and among humankind; and you made for yourself a name as the day this.

en.L: who set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, [and] until this day both in Israel and among humankind, and made for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} a name, as [it is] this day.
en.B: You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt and have done so to this day, both in Israel and among all humankind. You have made a name for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} that is known to this day.
en.R: You did signs and miracles in Egypt, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have kept on doing them until now, in Israel and among all people. Because of them {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are famous, as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are today.

es.L: que hiciste señales y prodigios en la tierra de Egipto [y] hasta este día, tanto en Israel como entre los hombres, y te hiciste un nombre, como [se ve] en este día.
es.B: Tú hiciste señales y prodigios en la tierra de Egipto, y los has seguido haciendo hasta hoy, tanto en Israel como entre toda la humanidad. Te has hecho un nombre que se conoce hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Tú hiciste señales y milagros en Egipto, y los has seguido haciendo hasta ahora, en Israel y entre toda la gente. Por ellos eres famoso, como lo eres hoy.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as accompli des signes et des prodiges au pays d’Égypte, [et] jusqu’à ce jour, en Israël et parmi les humains, et qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es fait un nom, comme [on le voit] aujourd’hui.
fr.B: Tu as accompli des signes et des prodiges au pays d’Égypte, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en accomplis jusqu’à ce jour, en Israël et parmi tous les humains. Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es fait un nom qui est connu aujourd’hui encore.
fr.R: Tu as fait des signes et des miracles en Égypte, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as continué à en faire jusqu’à maintenant, en Israël et chez tous les peuples. Grâce à eux, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es célèbre, comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’es aujourd’hui.

sw.L: uliyeweka ishara na maajabu katika nchi ya Misri, [na] hata siku hii ya leo katika Israeli na kati ya wanadamu, ukajifanyia jina, kama [ilivyo] siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Ulifanya ishara na maajabu katika nchi ya Misri, na umeendelea kufanya hivyo mpaka leo, katika Israeli na kati ya wanadamu wote. Umejifanyia jina linalojulikana mpaka leo.
sw.R: Ulifanya ishara na miujiza huko Misri, nawe umeendelea kuifanya mpaka sasa, katika Israeli na kati ya watu wote. Kwa sababu ya mambo hayo, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni maarufu, kama ulivyo leo.

vi.L: Ngài đã làm những dấu lạ và phép mầu trong xứ Ai Cập, [và] cho đến ngày nay, cả trong Y-sơ-ra-ên lẫn giữa loài người, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho mình một danh, như [hiện có] ngày nay.
vi.B: Ngài đã làm những dấu lạ và phép mầu trong xứ Ai Cập, và vẫn còn làm cho đến ngày nay, cả trong Y-sơ-ra-ên lẫn giữa cả loài người. Ngài đã làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết đến cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm những dấu lạ và phép lạ ở Ai Cập, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn tiếp tục làm như vậy cho đến nay, trong Y-sơ-ra-ên và giữa mọi dân tộc. Nhờ những việc ấy mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi danh, như ngày nay.

ko.L: 주님께서는 이집트 땅에서 표적과 기사를 행하셨고, 오늘날까지 이스라엘과 인류 가운데서 [그렇게 하셔서] 오늘과 같이 주님의 이름을 떨치셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 이집트 땅에서 표적과 기사를 행하셨고, 오늘날까지 이스라엘과 온 인류 가운데서 그렇게 하셨습니다. 그리하여 주님의 이름이 오늘날까지 널리 알려지게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 이집트에서 표적과 기적을 행하셨습니다. 그리고 지금까지 이스라엘과 모든 사람 가운데서 그런 일을 계속하셨습니다. 그래서 주님은 오늘날처럼 이름이 널리 알려지셨습니다.

pt.L: que puseste sinais e prodígios na terra do Egito, [e] até este dia, tanto em Israel como entre a humanidade, e fizeste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome, como [se vê] neste dia.
pt.B: Tu realizaste sinais e maravilhas na terra do Egito e continuas a realizá-los até hoje, tanto em Israel como entre toda a humanidade. Fizeste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome que é conhecido até hoje.
pt.R: Tu fizeste sinais e milagres no Egito, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} continuaste a fazê-los até agora, em Israel e entre todos os povos. Por causa deles {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és famoso, como és ainda hoje.

am.L: በግብፅ ምድር እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በእስራኤልና በሰዎች መካከል ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን አደረግህ፤ እንደ ዛሬውም ቀን ለራስህ ስም አደረግህ።
am.B: በግብፅ ምድር ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን አደረግህ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በእስራኤልና በሰው ዘር ሁሉ መካከል ታደርጋለህ። እስከ ዛሬ የሚታወቅ ስም ለራስህ አደረግህ።
am.R: በግብፅ ምልክቶችንና ተአምራትን አደረግህ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በእስራኤልና በሰዎች ሁሉ መካከል ማድረግህን አላቆምክም። በእነዚህም ዛሬ እንደሚታየው ዝነኛ ሆንክ።

hi.L: जिसने मिस्र देश में चिह्न और चमत्कार किए, [और] आज के दिन तक इस्राएल में भी और मनुष्यों के बीच भी, और अपने लिए ऐसा नाम किया जैसा आज के दिन [है]।
hi.B: तूने मिस्र देश में चिह्न और चमत्कार किए, और आज तक इस्राएल में और सब मनुष्यों के बीच करता आया है। तूने अपना ऐसा नाम किया है जो आज तक प्रसिद्ध है।
hi.R: तूने मिस्र में चिह्न और चमत्कार दिखाए, और आज तक इस्राएल में और सब लोगों के बीच दिखाता रहा है। इन्हीं के कारण तू प्रसिद्ध है, जैसा आज भी है।

ru.L: который совершил знамения и чудеса в земле Египта, [и] до этого дня — и в Израиле, и среди людей, и сделал себе имя, как [видно] в этот день.
ru.B: Ты совершил знамения и чудеса в земле Египта и совершаешь их до этого дня, и в Израиле, и среди всех людей. Ты сделал себе имя, которое известно и сегодня.
ru.R: Ты совершал знамения и чудеса в Египте и делаешь это до сих пор — и в Израиле, и среди всех людей. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} прославлен и сегодня.

ja.L: あなたは、エジプトの地でしるしと不思議を行われ、今日に至るまで、イスラエルの中でも人々の間でも[行われ]、今日のように、ご自分のために名を立てられました。
ja.B: あなたは、エジプトの地でしるしと不思議を行われ、今日に至るまで、イスラエルの中でも、すべての人々の間でも、それを行ってこられました。こうしてあなたは、今日も知られているとおり、ご自分の名を立てられたのです。
ja.R: あなたは、エジプトで、しるしと奇跡を行われました。そして今に至るまで、イスラエルの中でも、すべての人々の間でも、それを行い続けてこられました。そのため、今日のように、あなたの名は広く知られています。

uk.L: який учинив знаки й чудеса в землі Єгипту, [і] аж до цього дня і в Ізраїлі, і серед людей, і зробив собі імʼя, як [є] цього дня.
uk.B: Ти чинив знаки й чудеса в єгипетській землі і чиниш аж до цього дня, і в Ізраїлі, і серед усього людства. Ти здобув собі імʼя, відоме й донині.
uk.R: Ти чинив знаки й чудеса в Єгипті, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не переставав їх чинити аж дотепер, в Ізраїлі й серед усіх людей. Через них {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} славний, як і сьогодні.

decisions.choice: until this day, both in Israel and among humankind: God's acts of power have gone on since Egypt
alternatives: the signs done in Egypt are remembered to this day in Israel and among all people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on from Egypt to "until this day" and then names Israel and humankind. It is read as saying that the LORD who did wonders in Egypt has kept on doing them, among his people and the nations. It may instead mean that the signs done in Egypt are remembered to this day in Israel and among all people.

decisions.choice: signs and wonders: the plagues and other acts of power
decisions.reason: Signs point to the LORD and show who he is; wonders astonish. Together they name the plagues on Egypt (Deuteronomy 26:8).

decisions.choice: made yourself a name, as it is this day: became known for your deeds
decisions.reason: To make a name is to win fame and honor (Isaiah 63:12; Nehemiah 9:10). "As this day" means "as is still the case today".

decisions.choice: signs and wonders (L, B); signs and miracles (R)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 26:8, Readable says "miracles" for "wonders". Balanced and Readable start a new sentence with "You".

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ và phép mầu" (L, B); "dấu lạ và phép lạ" (R)
decisions.reason: "Dấu lạ" is the settled word for "sign"; the second word is "phép mầu" (wonder) at Literal and Balanced and the plainer "phép lạ" at Readable, as the English says "miracles".

decisions.choice: "표적과 기사" (L, B); "표적과 기적" (R)
decisions.reason: "표적" is the style guide's word for a sign; "기사" is the wonder of the exodus formula (meaning decision m2), and Readable uses the plainer "기적".

decisions.choice: sinais e prodígios (L); sinais e maravilhas (B); sinais e milagres (R)
decisions.reason: The pair (m2) keeps the words Deuteronomy 26:8 has in Portuguese at each level, as the English follows that verse; verse 21 repeats them.

decisions.choice: "ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን" for signs and wonders, as Deuteronomy on main
decisions.reason: The wording of Deuteronomy 4:34 and 6:22 in the Amharic Pentateuch, which this prayer echoes.

decisions.choice: себе
decisions.reason: The reflexive pronouns usually take no span, but here the English has one on "yourself" for God, and "себе" stands for God alone; the span follows the English.

decisions.choice: 'otot umofetim "しるしと不思議" (L, B), "しるしと奇跡" (R) (m2); 'ad hayyom hazzeh "今日に至るまで" (L, B), "今に至るまで" (R) (m1, uncertain); vatta'aseh lekha shem "ご自分のために名を立てられました" (L), "ご自分の名を立てられた" (B), "あなたの名は広く知られています" (R) (m3).
decisions.reason: Respect forms for God's acts in the prayer (行われ, 立てられ).

source.text: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you brought out your people Israel from [the] land of Egypt with signs and with wonders and with a hand strong and with an arm outstretched and with terror great;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and with wonders and with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with great terror.
en.B: With signs and wonders {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel out of the land of Egypt, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
en.R: With signs and miracles and with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great power, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel out of Egypt, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did terrifying things.

es.L: Y sacaste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel de la tierra de Egipto con señales y con prodigios, y con mano fuerte, y con brazo extendido, y con gran terror;
es.B: Con señales y prodigios sacaste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel de la tierra de Egipto, con mano poderosa y brazo extendido, y con gran terror.
es.R: Con señales y milagros y con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder, sacaste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel de Egipto, e hiciste cosas que causaban terror.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël du pays d’Égypte avec des signes et avec des prodiges, avec une main forte et avec un bras étendu, et avec une grande terreur.
fr.B: Par des signes et des prodiges, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël du pays d’Égypte, d’une main puissante et d’un bras étendu, en semant une grande terreur.
fr.R: Par des signes et des miracles et par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande puissance, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël d’Égypte, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait des choses terrifiantes.

sw.L: Nawe uliwatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli katika nchi ya Misri kwa ishara, na kwa maajabu, na kwa mkono wenye nguvu, na kwa mkono ulionyoshwa, na kwa utisho mkuu.
sw.B: Kwa ishara na maajabu uliwatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli katika nchi ya Misri, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyoshwa, na kwa utisho mkuu.
sw.R: Kwa ishara na miujiza na kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu, uliwatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli Misri, nawe ulifanya mambo ya kutisha.

vi.L: Ngài đã đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập bằng những dấu lạ, phép mầu, bằng bàn tay mạnh mẽ, cánh tay giơ ra và sự kinh hoàng lớn lao.
vi.B: Bằng những dấu lạ và phép mầu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, bằng bàn tay quyền năng và cánh tay giơ ra, cùng sự kinh hoàng lớn lao.
vi.R: Bằng những dấu lạ, phép lạ và quyền năng lớn lao của Ngài, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc khiến người ta kinh hãi.

ko.L: 그리고 주님께서는 표적과 기사와 강한 손과 펴신 팔과 큰 두려움으로 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 표적과 기사로, 강한 손과 뻗으신 팔로, 큰 두려움을 일으키시며 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 표적과 기적과 크신 능력으로 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 이집트에서 이끌어 내셨습니다. 그때 주님께서는 무서운 일들을 하셨습니다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiraste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel da terra do Egito com sinais e com prodígios, e com mão forte e com braço estendido, e com grande terror.
pt.B: Com sinais e maravilhas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiraste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel da terra do Egito, com mão poderosa e braço estendido, e com grande terror.
pt.R: Com sinais e milagres e com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} grande poder, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiraste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel do Egito, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste coisas assustadoras.

am.L: ሕዝብህንም እስራኤልን በምልክቶችና በድንቆች፣ በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ፣ በታላቅም ግርማ ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣህ፤
am.B: ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን በምልክቶችና በድንቆች፣ በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ፣ በታላቅም ግርማ ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣህ።
am.R: በምልክቶችና በተአምራት፣ በታላቁም ኃይልህ ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን ከግብፅ አወጣህ፤ የሚያስፈሩ ነገሮችንም አደረግህ።

hi.L: और तू अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल को चिह्नों और चमत्कारों से, और बलवंत हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से, और बड़े भय के साथ मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया।
hi.B: चिह्नों और चमत्कारों के साथ, सामर्थी हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से, और बड़े भयानक कामों के साथ तू अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल को मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया।
hi.R: चिह्नों और चमत्कारों से और अपनी बड़ी शक्ति से तू अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल को मिस्र से बाहर निकाल लाया, और तूने भयानक काम किए।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вывел {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ Израиль из земли Египта знамениями, и чудесами, и рукой сильной, и мышцей простёртой, и великим ужасом.
ru.B: Знамениями и чудесами {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вывел {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ Израиль из земли Египта, сильной рукой и простёртой мышцей, наводя великий ужас.
ru.R: Знамениями и чудесами, своей великой силой {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вывел {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ Израиль из Египта и совершил страшные дела.

ja.L: あなたは、しるしと不思議と、力強い手と伸ばした腕と、大いなる恐れをもって、あなたの民イスラエルをエジプトの地から導き出されました。
ja.B: あなたは、しるしと不思議をもって、力強い手と伸ばした腕をもって、また大いなる恐れをもって、あなたの民イスラエルをエジプトの地から導き出されました。
ja.R: あなたは、しるしと奇跡と大きな力で、あなたの民イスラエルをエジプトから導き出されました。そして、人々が恐れるようなことを行われました。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вивів {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ Ізраїль із землі Єгипту знаками, і чудесами, і рукою сильною, і раменом простягнутим, і великим страхом.
uk.B: Знаками й чудесами {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вивів {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ Ізраїль з єгипетської землі, могутньою рукою і простягнутим раменом, і з великим страхом.
uk.R: Знаками, чудесами й {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} великою силою {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вивів {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ Ізраїль з Єгипту, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чинив страшні речі.

decisions.choice: signs, wonders, a strong hand, an outstretched arm and great terror: the words of Deuteronomy 26:8
decisions.reason: Israel's confession at the offering of first fruits uses the same five phrases for the exodus (Deuteronomy 26:8; also 4:34). Jeremiah prays in the words of that confession. They are given as in Deuteronomy 26:8 at each level, in this verse's order.

decisions.choice: great terror: deeds that filled people with fear
decisions.reason: The word is fear or dread, here the awe that the LORD's acts in Egypt caused (Deuteronomy 26:8).

decisions.choice: with your great power (R); you did terrifying things (R)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 26:8, Readable explains the hand and arm as power and the terror as terrifying deeds.

decisions.choice: mão forte, braço estendido, grande terror (L); mão poderosa (B); grande poder, coisas assustadoras (R)
decisions.reason: The five phrases are those of Deuteronomy 26:8 (m1), and each level keeps that verse's Portuguese words.

decisions.choice: "በታላቅም ግርማ" (with great terror), as Deuteronomy 4:34 and 26:8 on main
decisions.reason: The Amharic Pentateuch's wording for the same phrase; Readable follows the English "terrifying things".

decisions.choice: बलवंत हाथ (L), सामर्थी हाथ (B); बढ़ाई हुई भुजा; बड़ा भय
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 26:8 keep that verse's wording in this translation at each level.

decisions.choice: рукой сильной, и мышцей простёртой, и великим ужасом (L); сильной рукой и простёртой мышцей (B); великой силой ... страшные дела (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 26:8 in this translation, level by level, since Jeremiah quotes that confession (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: beyad chazaqah uvizroa' netuyah uvemora' gadol "力強い手と伸ばした腕と、大いなる恐れをもって" (L, B), as DEU 26:8 (m1); R "大きな力" and "人々が恐れるようなこと" as the English R (m2).
decisions.reason: DEU wording of the exodus formula.

source.text: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you gave to them the land this which you swore to their fathers to give to them, a land flowing [with] milk and honey.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave them this land, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing [with] milk and honey.
en.B: You gave them this land that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had sworn to their ancestors to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
en.R: You gave them this land, as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had promised their ancestors. It was a land so rich that it flowed with milk and honey.

es.L: y les diste esta tierra, la cual juraste a sus padres que les darías, tierra que fluye leche y miel.
es.B: Les diste esta tierra que habías jurado dar a sus antepasados, una tierra que fluye leche y miel.
es.R: Les diste esta tierra, como lo habías prometido a sus antepasados. Era una tierra tan rica que fluía leche y miel.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as donné ce pays, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais juré à leurs pères de leur donner, un pays ruisselant de lait et de miel.
fr.B: Tu leur as donné ce pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais juré à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} de leur donner, un pays ruisselant de lait et de miel.
fr.R: Tu leur as donné ce pays, comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’avais promis à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. C’était un pays si riche qu’il ruisselait de lait et de miel.

sw.L: Nawe ukawapa nchi hii, uliyowaapia baba zao kwamba utawapa, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali.
sw.B: Uliwapa nchi hii uliyokuwa umewaapia babu zao kwamba utawapa, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali.
sw.R: Uliwapa nchi hii, kama ulivyowaahidi babu zao. Ilikuwa nchi yenye utajiri mwingi hata ikatiririka maziwa na asali.

vi.L: Ngài đã ban cho họ xứ này, là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề với tổ phụ họ là sẽ ban cho họ, một xứ đượm sữa và mật.
vi.B: Ngài đã ban cho họ xứ này, là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề với tổ tiên họ là sẽ ban cho họ, một xứ đượm sữa và mật.
vi.R: Ngài đã ban cho họ xứ này như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với tổ tiên họ. Đó là một xứ phì nhiêu, đượm sữa và mật.

ko.L: 그리고 주님께서는 그들의 조상들에게 주겠다고 맹세하신 이 땅, 곧 젖과 꿀이 흐르는 땅을 그들에게 주셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 그들의 조상들에게 주시겠다고 맹세하신 이 땅, 젖과 꿀이 흐르는 땅을 그들에게 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 그들의 조상들에게 약속하신 대로 이 땅을 그들에게 주셨습니다. 그 땅은 젖과 꿀이 흐를 만큼 기름진 땅이었습니다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lhes deste esta terra, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juraste aos pais deles que lhes darias, uma terra onde corre leite e mel.
pt.B: Tu lhes deste esta terra que tinhas jurado aos antepassados deles que lhes darias, uma terra onde corre leite e mel.
pt.R: Tu lhes deste esta terra, como tinhas prometido aos antepassados deles. Era uma terra tão rica que nela corria leite e mel.

am.L: ለአባቶቻቸው ልትሰጣቸው የማልህላቸውን ይህችን ምድር፣ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስ ምድር ሰጠሃቸው።
am.B: ለቅድመ አያቶቻቸው ልትሰጣቸው የማልህላቸውን ይህችን ምድር፣ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስ ምድር ሰጠሃቸው።
am.R: ለቅድመ አያቶቻቸው በሰጠሃቸው ተስፋ መሠረት ይህችን ምድር ሰጠሃቸው። ወተትና ማር የምታፈስ እስክትመስል ድረስ የለመለመች ምድር ነበረች።

hi.L: और तूने उन्हें यह देश दिया, जिसे उन्हें देने की शपथ तूने उनके पुरखाओं से खाई थी, ऐसा देश जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं।
hi.B: तूने उन्हें यह देश दिया, जिसे उनके पूर्वजों को देने की शपथ तूने खाई थी, ऐसा देश जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं।
hi.R: तूने उन्हें यह देश दिया, जैसा तूने उनके पूर्वजों से वादा किया था। यह इतना उपजाऊ देश था कि मानो उसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती थीं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} дал им эту землю, которую {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} клялся их отцам дать им, землю, текущую молоком и мёдом.
ru.B: Ты дал им эту землю, которую клятвенно обещал дать их предкам, — землю, где текут молоко и мёд.
ru.R: Ты дал им эту землю, как и обещал их предкам. Это была такая богатая земля, что в ней текли молоко и мёд.

ja.L: そして、彼らの父祖たちに与えると誓われたこの地、乳と蜜の流れる地を、彼らに与えられました。
ja.B: そして、彼らの先祖に与えると誓われたこの地、乳と蜜の流れる地を、彼らに与えられました。
ja.R: そして、彼らの先祖に約束されたとおり、この地を彼らに与えられました。そこは、乳と蜜が流れるほど豊かな地でした。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав їм цю землю, яку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} присягнув їхнім батькам дати їм, край, що тече молоком і медом.
uk.B: Ти дав їм цю землю, яку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} присягнув дати їхнім предкам, край, що тече молоком і медом.
uk.R: Ти дав їм цю землю, як {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} обіцяв їхнім предкам. Це був такий багатий край, що тік молоком і медом.

decisions.choice: which you swore to their fathers: the promise to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: The LORD had sworn to give the land to the patriarchs' descendants (Genesis 15:18; 26:3; Deuteronomy 1:8). Jeremiah 11:5 speaks of the same oath.

decisions.choice: a land flowing with milk and honey: a rich, fertile land
decisions.reason: Milk from flocks and honey, from bees or from fruit such as dates, stand for plenty (Exodus 3:8; Jeremiah 11:5).

decisions.choice: fathers (L); ancestors (B, R); so rich that it flowed (R)
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means ancestors. Readable explains the picture of milk and honey as in 11:5.

decisions.choice: पुरखा (L), पूर्वज (B, R); ऐसा देश जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं
decisions.reason: "Fathers" meaning ancestors as in 24:10; the land flowing with milk and honey in the Pentateuch note's wording.

decisions.choice: предки (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the ancestors, men and women, so Balanced and Readable say "предки", as in Jeremiah 16:11; Literal keeps "отцы".

decisions.choice: 'erets zavat chalav udevash "乳と蜜の流れる地" (L, B), "乳と蜜が流れるほど豊かな地" (R), as JER 11:5 (m2); nishba'ta "誓われた" (L, B), "約束された" (R) (m1); 'avotam "父祖たち" (L), "先祖" (B, R).
decisions.reason: JER-2 words.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֨ךָ֙ וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ֣ לֹא־הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came in and they took possession of it, but not they listened to your voice and in your instruction not they walked; all that you commanded to them to do not they did; and you made meet them all the disaster this.

en.L: And they came in and took possession of it, but they did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} voice, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction they did not walk; all that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} commanded them to do, they did not do; and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made all this disaster meet them.
en.B: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} voice or live by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction. They did nothing of all {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had commanded them to do, and so {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made all this disaster fall on them.
en.R: They went in and took it for their own. But they did not obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} or follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching. They did not do any of the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} commanded them. So {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have brought all this trouble on them.

es.L: Y entraron y la poseyeron, pero no escucharon {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz, ni anduvieron en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción; nada de lo que les mandaste hacer hicieron; y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho venir sobre ellos todo este mal.
es.B: Entraron y tomaron posesión de ella, pero no obedecieron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz ni vivieron según {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción. No hicieron nada de lo que les habías mandado hacer, y por eso has hecho caer sobre ellos toda esta desgracia.
es.R: Entraron y la hicieron suya. Pero no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecieron ni siguieron {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza. No hicieron nada de lo que les mandaste. Por eso has traído sobre ellos todo este mal.

fr.L: Et ils sont entrés et en ont pris possession, mais ils n’ont pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} voix, et dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi ils n’ont pas marché ; tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur avais ordonné de faire, ils ne l’ont pas fait ; et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait venir sur eux tout ce malheur.
